q.en: In short-form video (Reels/Shorts), what is the 'hook'?
q.hi: Short-form video (Reels/Shorts) mein 'hook' kya hota hai?
q.mr: Short-form video (Reels/Shorts) मध्ये 'hook' म्हणजे काय?

en: The first 1-3 seconds designed to stop the scroll
The link placed in your bio
The licence for background music
The end-screen subscribe button
hi: Pehle 1-3 seconds jo scroll rokne ke liye banaye jaate hain
Bio mein diya link
Background music ka licence
End-screen ka subscribe button
mr: Scroll थांबवण्यासाठी बनवलेले पहिले 1-3 सेकंद
Bio मधील link
Background music चे licence
End-screen वरील subscribe button

exp.en: The hook is the opening line, visual or text overlay that makes viewers stop scrolling. If the hook fails, watch time and reach suffer no matter how good the rest is.
exp.hi: Hook opening line, visual ya text overlay hai jo viewers ka scroll rokta hai. Hook fail hua toh baaki video kitna bhi achha ho, watch time aur reach girte hain.
exp.mr: Hook म्हणजे सुरुवातीची line, visual किंवा text overlay जो viewers चा scroll थांबवतो. Hook fail झाला तर बाकी व्हिडिओ कितीही चांगला असला तरी watch time आणि reach कमी होतात.

q.en: Which Meta audience type lets you show ads to people who visited your website in the last 30 days?
q.hi: Pichhle 30 din mein website visit karne walon ko ads dikhane ke liye Meta ki kaunsi audience type use karte hain?
q.mr: गेल्या 30 दिवसांत website ला भेट दिलेल्या लोकांना ads दाखवण्यासाठी Meta ची कोणती audience type वापरतात?

en: Lookalike Audience
Website Custom Audience (built from Pixel data)
Detailed targeting by interests
Broad audience with no inputs
hi: Lookalike Audience
Website Custom Audience (Pixel data se bani)
Interests wali detailed targeting
Bina inputs wali broad audience
mr: Lookalike Audience
Website Custom Audience (Pixel data वरून बनवलेली)
Interests नुसार detailed targeting
कोणतेही inputs नसलेली broad audience

exp.en: A Website Custom Audience uses Pixel/CAPI events to retarget past visitors for a chosen time window. A Lookalike finds new people similar to them instead.
exp.hi: Website Custom Audience Pixel/CAPI events se past visitors ko chune hue time window ke liye retarget karti hai. Lookalike unke jaise naye log dhoondhti hai.
exp.mr: Website Custom Audience Pixel/CAPI events वापरून निवडलेल्या कालावधीतील visitors ना retarget करते. Lookalike त्यांच्यासारखे नवे लोक शोधते.

q.en: What is a key advantage of LinkedIn Lead Gen Forms?
q.hi: LinkedIn Lead Gen Forms ka ek bada fayda kya hai?
q.mr: LinkedIn Lead Gen Forms चा एक मोठा फायदा कोणता?

en: They only work for job postings
They guarantee a sale for every lead
They pre-fill profile data, so users submit without leaving LinkedIn
They send leads straight into WhatsApp groups
hi: Yeh sirf job postings ke liye kaam karte hain
Har lead se sale ki guarantee dete hain
Profile data pre-fill hota hai, user LinkedIn chhode bina submit karta hai
Leads seedha WhatsApp groups mein bhejte hain
mr: हे फक्त job postings साठी चालतात
प्रत्येक lead मधून sale ची guarantee देतात
Profile data आधीच भरलेला असतो, user LinkedIn न सोडता submit करतो
Leads थेट WhatsApp groups मध्ये पाठवतात

exp.en: Lead Gen Forms auto-fill details like name, email, company and job title from the profile, which reduces friction, especially on mobile.
exp.hi: Lead Gen Forms profile se naam, email, company, job title auto-fill kar dete hain, jisse friction kam hota hai, khaaskar mobile pe.
exp.mr: Lead Gen Forms profile वरून नाव, email, company, job title आपोआप भरतात, त्यामुळे friction कमी होते, विशेषतः mobile वर.

q.en: In India, influencer ad disclosure guidelines are issued by ASCI. What does ASCI stand for?
q.hi: India mein influencer ad disclosure guidelines ASCI deta hai. ASCI ka full form kya hai?
q.mr: भारतात influencer ad disclosure guidelines ASCI देते. ASCI चे पूर्ण रूप काय?

en: All-India Social Content Institute
Association of Social Creators of India
Advertising Standards Committee of Instagram
Advertising Standards Council of India
hi: All-India Social Content Institute
Association of Social Creators of India
Advertising Standards Committee of Instagram
Advertising Standards Council of India
mr: All-India Social Content Institute
Association of Social Creators of India
Advertising Standards Committee of Instagram
Advertising Standards Council of India

exp.en: ASCI (Advertising Standards Council of India) is the self-regulatory body for advertising. Its influencer guidelines (2021) require clear disclosure of paid or sponsored content.
exp.hi: ASCI (Advertising Standards Council of India) advertising ki self-regulatory body hai. Iske influencer guidelines (2021) paid/sponsored content ka clear disclosure maangte hain.
exp.mr: ASCI (Advertising Standards Council of India) ही advertising ची self-regulatory संस्था आहे. तिच्या influencer guidelines (2021) नुसार paid/sponsored content स्पष्टपणे disclose करणे आवश्यक आहे.

q.en: Meta says an ad set usually exits the learning phase after roughly how many optimization events?
q.hi: Meta ke hisaab se ad set roughly kitne optimization events ke baad learning phase se bahar aata hai?
q.mr: Meta नुसार ad set साधारण किती optimization events नंतर learning phase मधून बाहेर पडतो?

en: About 50 within 7 days of the last significant edit
About 5 within 24 hours of launch
About 500 within 30 days
After exactly ₹10,000 of spend
hi: Last significant edit ke 7 din ke andar lagbhag 50
Launch ke 24 ghante mein lagbhag 5
30 din mein lagbhag 500
Theek ₹10,000 spend hone ke baad
mr: शेवटच्या significant edit नंतर 7 दिवसांत सुमारे 50
Launch नंतर 24 तासांत सुमारे 5
बरोबर ₹10,000 खर्च झाल्यावर

exp.en: Meta's guidance is around 50 optimization events in a 7-day window. Too few events leaves the ad set 'Learning limited', with less stable delivery and cost.
exp.hi: Meta ki guidance hai 7 din mein lagbhag 50 optimization events. Events kam hon toh ad set 'Learning limited' mein rehta hai aur delivery-cost unstable rehte hain.
exp.mr: Meta च्या guidance नुसार 7 दिवसांत सुमारे 50 optimization events हवेत. Events कमी असतील तर ad set 'Learning limited' मध्ये राहतो आणि delivery व cost अस्थिर राहतात.

q.en: A Pune bakery with a ₹8,000/month budget wants more walk-in customers from nearby areas. Which Meta ad setup makes the most sense?
q.hi: Pune ki ek bakery ka budget ₹8,000/month hai aur use aas-paas se zyada walk-in customers chahiye. Kaunsa Meta ad setup sabse sahi hai?
q.mr: Pune मधील एका bakery चे budget ₹8,000/महिना आहे आणि त्यांना जवळपासच्या भागातून जास्त walk-in customers हवे आहेत. कोणता Meta ad setup सर्वात योग्य?

en: Target all of India to get maximum reach
Target a few km around the shop with product Reels and an address/WhatsApp CTA
Target people interested in 'baking' worldwide
Randomly boost old posts whenever sales are slow
hi: Maximum reach ke liye poore India ko target karna
Shop ke aas-paas kuch km target karke product Reels aur address/WhatsApp CTA
Duniya bhar mein 'baking' interest walon ko target karna
Sales slow hone pe random purane posts boost karna
mr: जास्तीत जास्त reach साठी संपूर्ण भारत target करणे
दुकानाभोवती काही km target करून product Reels आणि address/WhatsApp CTA
जगभरातील 'baking' interest असलेल्यांना target करणे
Sales कमी झाल्यावर जुन्या posts random boost करणे

exp.en: A local business only earns from people who can actually visit, so a tight radius plus appetising creative and an easy way to find or message the shop spends the small budget well. National or global targeting wastes it.
exp.hi: Local business ko sirf un logon se kamaai hoti hai jo shop tak aa sakein, isliye chhota radius, tempting creative aur shop tak pahunchne ya message karne ka aasaan tareeka chhote budget ka sahi use hai. National/global targeting paisa waste karti hai.
exp.mr: Local business ला फक्त दुकानापर्यंत येऊ शकणाऱ्या लोकांकडून कमाई होते, म्हणून लहान radius, आकर्षक creative आणि दुकान शोधण्याचा/message करण्याचा सोपा मार्ग हा लहान budget चा योग्य वापर आहे. National/global targeting पैसा वाया घालवते.

q.en: An influencer's paid Reel caption ends with 25 hashtags, with '#sp' hidden in the middle. What do ASCI's influencer guidelines require instead?
q.hi: Ek influencer ke paid Reel caption ke end mein 25 hashtags hain aur '#sp' beech mein chhupa hai. ASCI influencer guidelines iski jagah kya maangti hain?
q.mr: एका influencer च्या paid Reel caption च्या शेवटी 25 hashtags आहेत आणि '#sp' मध्ये लपलेला आहे. ASCI influencer guidelines याऐवजी काय सांगतात?

en: Nothing more; any hashtag counts as disclosure
Only a thank-you to the brand in the comments
A clear label like #ad or 'Sponsored', placed upfront and prominently
Disclosure only once in the influencer's bio
hi: Kuch nahi; koi bhi hashtag disclosure maana jaata hai
Sirf comments mein brand ko thank-you
#ad ya 'Sponsored' jaisa clear label, shuru mein aur prominently
Sirf influencer ke bio mein ek baar disclosure
mr: काही नाही; कोणताही hashtag disclosure मानला जातो
फक्त comments मध्ये brand ला thank-you
#ad किंवा 'Sponsored' सारखे स्पष्ट label, सुरुवातीला आणि ठळकपणे
फक्त influencer च्या bio मध्ये एकदा disclosure

exp.en: ASCI requires clear labels such as Ad, Advertisement, Sponsored, Collaboration or Partnership, placed where users can't miss them, not buried among hashtags. For videos the label should also appear on the video itself.
exp.hi: ASCI Ad, Advertisement, Sponsored, Collaboration ya Partnership jaise clear labels maangta hai jo miss na hon, hashtags ke dher mein chhupe na hon. Video mein label video pe bhi dikhna chahiye.
exp.mr: ASCI नुसार Ad, Advertisement, Sponsored, Collaboration किंवा Partnership सारखे स्पष्ट labels हवेत जे चुकणार नाहीत, hashtags मध्ये लपलेले नकोत. व्हिडिओमध्ये label व्हिडिओवरही दिसले पाहिजे.

q.en: In YouTube Studio, which metric best shows whether your thumbnail and title are earning the click?
q.hi: YouTube Studio mein kaunsa metric sabse achhe se batata hai ki thumbnail aur title click la rahe hain ya nahi?
q.mr: YouTube Studio मध्ये thumbnail आणि title click मिळवत आहेत का हे कोणता metric सर्वात चांगले दाखवतो?

en: Average view duration
Total subscriber count
Watch time (hours)
Impressions click-through rate
hi: Average view duration
Total subscriber count
Watch time (hours)
Impressions click-through rate
mr: Average view duration
Total subscriber count
Watch time (hours)
Impressions click-through rate

exp.en: Impressions CTR is the share of thumbnail impressions that turned into views, so it directly reflects thumbnail + title appeal. View duration measures what happens after the click.
exp.hi: Impressions CTR batata hai thumbnail impressions mein se kitne views bane, yaani seedha thumbnail + title ki appeal. View duration click ke baad ka haal batata hai.
exp.mr: Impressions CTR म्हणजे thumbnail impressions पैकी किती views झाले, म्हणजे थेट thumbnail + title चे आकर्षण. View duration click नंतर काय होते ते मोजते.

q.en: A coaching institute adds 30 generic hashtags (#love #instagood #viral) to every post, but reach stays tiny. What is the best fix?
q.hi: Ek coaching institute har post mein 30 generic hashtags (#love #instagood #viral) daalta hai, par reach bahut kam hai. Best fix kya hai?
q.mr: एक coaching institute प्रत्येक post मध्ये 30 generic hashtags (#love #instagood #viral) टाकते, पण reach खूपच कमी आहे. सर्वोत्तम उपाय कोणता?

en: Use a few specific, relevant hashtags and focus on content and keyword-rich captions
Increase to 60 hashtags so the post appears in more places
Repeat the same hashtags in the comments too
Stop posting and only run Stories
hi: Kuch specific, relevant hashtags use karo aur content va keyword-rich captions pe focus karo
60 hashtags kar do taaki post zyada jagah dikhe
Wahi hashtags comments mein bhi repeat karo
Posting band karke sirf Stories chalao
mr: थोडे specific, relevant hashtags वापरा आणि content व keyword-rich captions वर लक्ष द्या
Post जास्त ठिकाणी दिसावी म्हणून 60 hashtags करा
तेच hashtags comments मध्येही टाका
Posting बंद करून फक्त Stories चालवा

exp.en: Hashtags only help categorise content; generic ones like #love are flooded and irrelevant to students. A few niche tags (e.g. #MPSCpreparation) plus strong content and clear captions help Instagram understand and show the post to the right people.
exp.hi: Hashtags sirf content categorise karte hain; #love jaise generic tags bhare pade hain aur students ke liye irrelevant hain. Kuch niche tags (jaise #MPSCpreparation) plus strong content aur clear captions se Instagram post ko sahi logon tak dikhata hai.
exp.mr: Hashtags फक्त content categorise करतात; #love सारखे generic tags गर्दीचे आणि विद्यार्थ्यांसाठी अप्रस्तुत आहेत. थोडे niche tags (उदा. #MPSCpreparation), दमदार content आणि स्पष्ट captions मुळे Instagram post योग्य लोकांना दाखवते.

q.en: A D2C brand gets an angry public comment on Instagram about a delivery that is 10 days late. What should the social team do?
q.hi: Ek D2C brand ko Instagram pe 10 din late delivery ko lekar gussa bhara public comment mila. Social team ko kya karna chahiye?
q.mr: एका D2C brand ला Instagram वर 10 दिवस उशिरा आलेल्या delivery बद्दल रागावलेली public comment आली. Social team ने काय करावे?

en: Delete the comment quickly so others don't see it
Reply publicly with empathy, move order details to DM, fix it and follow up
Ignore it; replying only draws more attention
Reply with a copy-paste 'Check our FAQ' message
hi: Comment turant delete karo taaki koi na dekhe
Public mein empathy ke saath reply karo, order details DM mein lo, solve karo aur follow up karo
Ignore karo; reply karne se aur attention milega
Copy-paste 'Hamara FAQ dekhein' reply karo
mr: इतरांनी पाहू नये म्हणून comment लगेच delete करा
Public मध्ये सहानुभूतीने reply करा, order details DM मध्ये घ्या, प्रश्न सोडवा आणि follow up करा
दुर्लक्ष करा; reply केल्याने जास्त लक्ष जाईल
Copy-paste 'आमचे FAQ पाहा' reply करा

exp.en: A fast, human public reply shows other customers you care, while DMs protect private order data. Deleting or ignoring genuine complaints usually makes people angrier and can escalate publicly.
exp.hi: Fast aur human public reply baaki customers ko dikhata hai ki brand care karta hai, aur DM mein private order data safe rehta hai. Genuine complaint delete ya ignore karne se gussa aur badhta hai.
exp.mr: जलद आणि माणुसकीचा public reply इतर ग्राहकांना दाखवतो की brand काळजी घेतो, आणि DM मध्ये private order data सुरक्षित राहतो. खरी तक्रार delete किंवा दुर्लक्ष केल्यास राग वाढतो.

q.en: What does choosing Advantage+ placements do in a Meta campaign?
q.hi: Meta campaign mein Advantage+ placements choose karne se kya hota hai?
q.mr: Meta campaign मध्ये Advantage+ placements निवडल्यावर काय होते?

en: Shows ads only in the Facebook Feed
Doubles your daily budget automatically
Lets Meta spread delivery across placements where results are likely best
Restricts ads to Instagram Stories only
hi: Ads sirf Facebook Feed mein dikhte hain
Daily budget automatically double ho jaata hai
Meta un placements pe delivery phailata hai jahan results best hone ki sambhavna ho
Ads sirf Instagram Stories tak limited ho jaate hain
mr: Ads फक्त Facebook Feed मध्ये दिसतात
Daily budget आपोआप दुप्पट होते
ज्या placements वर results चांगले येण्याची शक्यता आहे तिथे Meta delivery पसरवते
Ads फक्त Instagram Stories पुरत्या मर्यादित होतात

exp.en: Advantage+ placements (formerly automatic placements) give the system more inventory (Feeds, Stories, Reels, etc.) to find cheaper results. It does not change your budget.
exp.hi: Advantage+ placements (pehle automatic placements) system ko zyada inventory (Feeds, Stories, Reels, etc.) dete hain taaki sasta result mile. Isse budget change nahi hota.
exp.mr: Advantage+ placements (पूर्वीचे automatic placements) system ला जास्त inventory (Feeds, Stories, Reels इ.) देतात म्हणजे स्वस्त results मिळतात. यामुळे budget बदलत नाही.

q.en: When creating a Meta Lookalike Audience, what does choosing 1% instead of 10% mean?
q.hi: Meta Lookalike banate waqt 10% ki jagah 1% choose karne ka matlab kya hai?
q.mr: Meta Lookalike बनवताना 10% ऐवजी 1% निवडण्याचा अर्थ काय?

en: 1% is broader and less similar to the source
1% costs exactly 10 times less
1% only includes your existing customers
1% is smaller and most similar to the source
hi: 1% zyada broad hai aur source se kam milta-julta hai
1% theek 10 guna sasta hota hai
1% mein sirf existing customers hote hain
1% chhota hai aur source se sabse zyada milta-julta hai
mr: 1% जास्त broad आणि source शी कमी साम्य असलेले
1% बरोबर 10 पट स्वस्त असते
1% मध्ये फक्त existing customers असतात
1% लहान आणि source शी सर्वात जास्त साम्य असलेले

exp.en: The percentage is the share of the country's population included: 1% is the closest match to your source, 10% is larger but less similar. Existing customers themselves are a Custom Audience.
exp.hi: Percentage country ki population ka hissa hai: 1% source se sabse close match, 10% bada par kam similar. Existing customers khud Custom Audience hote hain.
exp.mr: Percentage म्हणजे देशातील लोकसंख्येचा हिस्सा: 1% source शी सर्वात जवळचे, 10% मोठे पण कमी साम्य असलेले. Existing customers स्वतः Custom Audience असतात.

q.en: A new D2C store gets about 5 purchases a week. Its Meta ad sets optimizing for Purchase show 'Learning limited'. What is the most sensible fix?
q.hi: Ek naye D2C store ko hafte mein lagbhag 5 purchases milte hain. Purchase ke liye optimize ho rahe Meta ad sets 'Learning limited' dikha rahe hain. Sabse samajhdaar fix kya hai?
q.mr: एका नव्या D2C store ला आठवड्याला सुमारे 5 purchases मिळतात. Purchase साठी optimize होणारे Meta ad sets 'Learning limited' दाखवत आहेत. सर्वात योग्य उपाय कोणता?

en: Consolidate ad sets and/or optimize for a more frequent event like Add to Cart
Split into even more ad sets with smaller budgets
Edit targeting every day until learning ends
Switch the objective to Awareness permanently
hi: Ad sets consolidate karo aur/ya Add to Cart jaise zyada frequent event pe optimize karo
Aur zyada ad sets banao chhote budgets ke saath
Learning khatam hone tak roz targeting edit karo
Objective ko hamesha ke liye Awareness kar do
mr: Ad sets एकत्र करा आणि/किंवा Add to Cart सारख्या जास्त वेळा होणाऱ्या event साठी optimize करा
लहान budgets सह आणखी ad sets बनवा
Learning संपेपर्यंत रोज targeting edit करा
Objective कायमचा Awareness करा

exp.en: Learning needs enough optimization events (around 50/week). Fewer, bigger ad sets or a higher-volume event gives the algorithm that data. Splitting further or editing daily resets and starves learning.
exp.hi: Learning ko kaafi optimization events chahiye (lagbhag 50/week). Kam aur bade ad sets ya zyada volume wala event algorithm ko data deta hai. Aur split karna ya roz edit karna learning ko reset aur bhookha rakhta hai.
exp.mr: Learning साठी पुरेसे optimization events (सुमारे 50/आठवडा) लागतात. कमी पण मोठे ad sets किंवा जास्त volume चा event algorithm ला data देतो. आणखी split करणे किंवा रोज edit करणे learning reset करते.

q.en: You send the same Purchase event from both the Meta Pixel and the Conversions API. How does Meta avoid counting it twice?
q.hi: Aap same Purchase event Meta Pixel aur Conversions API dono se bhejte ho. Meta ise do baar count hone se kaise bachata hai?
q.mr: तुम्ही एकच Purchase event Meta Pixel आणि Conversions API दोन्हीकडून पाठवता. Meta ते दोनदा मोजणे कसे टाळते?

en: It always ignores server events if a pixel exists
By matching the same event name and event_id from both sources
By counting only events that happen before midnight
It can't; you must turn off the pixel
hi: Pixel ho toh server events hamesha ignore karta hai
Dono sources se same event name aur event_id match karke
Sirf midnight se pehle ke events count karke
Nahi kar sakta; pixel band karna padega
mr: Pixel असेल तर server events नेहमी ignore करतो
दोन्ही sources कडून आलेले same event name आणि event_id जुळवून
फक्त मध्यरात्रीपूर्वीचे events मोजून
शक्य नाही; pixel बंद करावा लागतो

exp.en: Deduplication works when browser and server events share the same event name and a matching event_id. Running both with dedup gives better coverage than either alone.
exp.hi: Deduplication tab hota hai jab browser aur server events ka event name same ho aur event_id match kare. Dedup ke saath dono chalana akele kisi ek se better coverage deta hai.
exp.mr: Browser आणि server events चे event name सारखे आणि event_id जुळणारे असल्यास deduplication होते. Dedup सह दोन्ही वापरल्याने एकट्यापेक्षा चांगले coverage मिळते.

q.en: A Mumbai dental clinic's Meta instant-form leads are cheap, but many give wrong numbers or don't remember signing up. What change will most likely improve lead quality?
q.hi: Mumbai ke ek dental clinic ke Meta instant-form leads saste hain, par kaafi log galat number dete hain ya bhool jaate hain ki sign up kiya tha. Lead quality sudharne ke liye sabse achha change kya hai?
q.mr: Mumbai मधील एका dental clinic चे Meta instant-form leads स्वस्त आहेत, पण बरेच जण चुकीचा नंबर देतात किंवा sign up केल्याचे विसरतात. Lead quality सुधारण्यासाठी सर्वात चांगला बदल कोणता?

en: Remove all form questions to get more leads
Switch the objective to Traffic
Use the 'Higher intent' form type and add a qualifying question
Target a wider age range with the same form
hi: Zyada leads ke liye form ke saare questions hata do
Objective Traffic kar do
'Higher intent' form type use karo aur ek qualifying question jodo
Same form ke saath wider age range target karo
mr: जास्त leads साठी form मधले सर्व प्रश्न काढा
Objective Traffic करा
'Higher intent' form type वापरा आणि एक qualifying प्रश्न जोडा
त्याच form सह wider age range target करा

exp.en: The Higher intent form adds a review step before submitting, and a qualifying question (e.g. which treatment, preferred area) filters casual clicks. Fewer questions raise volume but usually lower quality.
exp.hi: Higher intent form submit se pehle review step jodta hai, aur qualifying question (jaise kaunsa treatment, kaunsa area) casual clicks ko filter karta hai. Kam questions se volume badhta hai par quality aam taur pe girti hai.
exp.mr: Higher intent form submit करण्यापूर्वी review step जोडतो, आणि qualifying प्रश्न (उदा. कोणती treatment, कोणता भाग) casual clicks गाळतो. कमी प्रश्नांनी volume वाढतो पण quality सहसा घटते.

q.en: On X (formerly Twitter), what are Community Notes?
q.hi: X (pehle Twitter) pe Community Notes kya hote hain?
q.mr: X (पूर्वीचे Twitter) वर Community Notes म्हणजे काय?

en: Paid badges for verified brands
Private notes only the poster can see
Scheduled posts for community pages
Crowd-sourced context added to posts that may be misleading
hi: Verified brands ke paid badges
Private notes jo sirf poster dekh sakta hai
Community pages ke scheduled posts
Misleading ho sakne wale posts pe crowd-sourced context
mr: Verified brands साठी paid badges
फक्त poster ला दिसणाऱ्या private notes
Community pages साठी scheduled posts
दिशाभूल करू शकणाऱ्या posts वर crowd-sourced context

exp.en: Community Notes let contributors add context to posts, shown when raters from different viewpoints agree it is helpful. Brands and ads can get notes too, so exaggerated claims can backfire publicly.
exp.hi: Community Notes mein contributors posts pe context jodte hain, jo tab dikhta hai jab alag-alag viewpoint ke raters maanein ki helpful hai. Brands aur ads pe bhi notes lag sakte hain, isliye exaggerated claims public mein ulte pad sakte hain.
exp.mr: Community Notes मध्ये contributors posts वर context जोडतात, जे वेगवेगळ्या मतांचे raters उपयोगी म्हणतात तेव्हा दिसते. Brands आणि ads वरही notes येऊ शकतात, त्यामुळे अतिशयोक्त दावे उलटू शकतात.

q.en: A customer posts a great unboxing video of your skincare product. Your team wants to use it in paid ads. What must you do first?
q.hi: Ek customer ne aapke skincare product ka shaandaar unboxing video post kiya. Team use paid ads mein use karna chahti hai. Pehle kya karna zaroori hai?
q.mr: एका ग्राहकाने तुमच्या skincare product चा उत्तम unboxing video post केला. Team ला तो paid ads मध्ये वापरायचा आहे. आधी काय करणे आवश्यक आहे?

en: Get the creator's explicit permission (usage rights) and agree on credit
Download it and run it; public posts are free to use
Re-upload it after adding your logo to make it yours
Use it only if it has more than 10,000 views
hi: Creator se explicit permission (usage rights) lo aur credit tay karo
Download karke chala do; public posts free hote hain
Apna logo lagakar re-upload karo, toh apna ho gaya
Sirf 10,000 se zyada views ho tabhi use karo
mr: Creator ची स्पष्ट परवानगी (usage rights) घ्या आणि credit ठरवा
Download करून चालवा; public posts free असतात
आपला logo लावून re-upload करा, म्हणजे तो आपला झाला
10,000 पेक्षा जास्त views असतील तरच वापरा

exp.en: Public doesn't mean free to use: the customer owns the content, so you need written permission for ad use (and ideally agree on duration and credit). Adding a logo doesn't transfer ownership.
exp.hi: Public ka matlab free nahi: content customer ka hai, isliye ad use ke liye written permission chahiye (duration aur credit bhi tay karo). Logo lagane se ownership nahi badalti.
exp.mr: Public म्हणजे free नाही: content ग्राहकाचे आहे, म्हणून ad मध्ये वापरण्यासाठी लेखी परवानगी हवी (कालावधी आणि credit ही ठरवा). Logo लावल्याने ownership बदलत नाही.

q.en: In 2025, Instagram's head named a few key signals for Reels reach. Which one is especially tied to reaching non-followers?
q.hi: 2025 mein Instagram ke head ne Reels reach ke kuch key signals bataye. Inmein se kaunsa non-followers tak pahunchne se khaas juda hai?
q.mr: 2025 मध्ये Instagram च्या प्रमुखांनी Reels reach चे काही key signals सांगितले. त्यापैकी कोणता non-followers पर्यंत पोहोचण्याशी विशेष जोडलेला आहे?

en: The number of hashtags in the caption
Sends: how often people share it by DM, relative to reach
How long the caption text is
Whether the account has a Verified badge
hi: Caption mein kitne hashtags hain
Sends: reach ke hisaab se log kitni baar DM mein share karte hain
Caption text kitna lamba hai
Account pe Verified badge hai ya nahi
mr: Caption मध्ये किती hashtags आहेत
Sends: reach च्या तुलनेत लोक किती वेळा DM मध्ये share करतात
Caption text किती लांब आहे
Account ला Verified badge आहे की नाही

exp.en: Adam Mosseri highlighted watch time, likes per reach and sends per reach, with sends being especially strong for reaching new, unconnected audiences. Hashtag count and caption length are not key ranking signals.
exp.hi: Adam Mosseri ne watch time, likes per reach aur sends per reach highlight kiye, aur sends naye, unconnected audience tak pahunchne ke liye khaas strong hain. Hashtag count aur caption length key signals nahi hain.
exp.mr: Adam Mosseri यांनी watch time, likes per reach आणि sends per reach सांगितले; नव्या, न जोडलेल्या audience पर्यंत पोहोचण्यासाठी sends विशेष महत्त्वाचे आहेत. Hashtags ची संख्या किंवा caption ची लांबी हे मुख्य signals नाहीत.

q.en: Which Meta setup lets you directly set a frequency cap, e.g. 'no more than 2 impressions per person every 7 days'?
q.hi: Kaunse Meta setup mein aap seedha frequency cap set kar sakte ho, jaise '7 din mein ek insaan ko 2 se zyada impressions nahi'?
q.mr: कोणत्या Meta setup मध्ये थेट frequency cap लावता येतो, उदा. '7 दिवसांत एका व्यक्तीला 2 पेक्षा जास्त impressions नाहीत'?

en: Sales objective optimizing for Purchase
Leads objective with instant forms
Awareness objective with the Reach performance goal
Traffic objective optimizing for link clicks
hi: Purchase ke liye optimize hota Sales objective
Instant forms wala Leads objective
Reach performance goal ke saath Awareness objective
Link clicks ke liye optimize hota Traffic objective
mr: Purchase साठी optimize होणारा Sales objective
Instant forms असलेला Leads objective
Reach performance goal सह Awareness objective
Link clicks साठी optimize होणारा Traffic objective

exp.en: Frequency controls are available when optimizing for Reach under Awareness, because the goal is spreading impressions across people. Conversion-focused goals let the system decide frequency.
exp.hi: Frequency control Awareness ke andar Reach optimize karte waqt milta hai, kyunki goal impressions ko zyada logon mein baantna hai. Conversion goals mein frequency system khud decide karta hai.
exp.mr: Awareness अंतर्गत Reach साठी optimize करताना frequency control मिळतो, कारण उद्देश impressions जास्त लोकांमध्ये वाटणे हा आहे. Conversion goals मध्ये frequency system स्वतः ठरवते.

q.en: What do LinkedIn 'Thought Leader Ads' let a company do?
q.hi: LinkedIn 'Thought Leader Ads' se company kya kar sakti hai?
q.mr: LinkedIn 'Thought Leader Ads' मुळे company काय करू शकते?

en: Send InMail to anyone without a connection
Buy a blue verification tick for the page
Boost job posts to the top of search
Promote posts from people's personal profiles (e.g. founders, employees), with their approval
hi: Bina connection kisi ko bhi InMail bhejna
Page ke liye blue verification tick khareedna
Job posts ko search mein top pe boost karna
Logon ke personal profiles (jaise founders, employees) ke posts unki approval se promote karna
mr: Connection नसतानाही कोणालाही InMail पाठवणे
Page साठी blue verification tick विकत घेणे
Job posts search मध्ये वर boost करणे
लोकांच्या personal profiles (उदा. founders, employees) वरील posts त्यांच्या मंजुरीने promote करणे

exp.en: Thought Leader Ads sponsor posts from individual members' profiles, which often feel more human and get better engagement than company-page ads. The member must approve the promotion.
exp.hi: Thought Leader Ads individual members ke profile posts ko sponsor karte hain, jo company-page ads se zyada human lagte hain aur achha engagement laate hain. Member ki approval zaroori hai.
exp.mr: Thought Leader Ads व्यक्तींच्या profile वरील posts sponsor करतात, जे company-page ads पेक्षा जास्त मानवी वाटतात आणि चांगले engagement मिळवतात. त्या व्यक्तीची मंजुरी आवश्यक असते.

q.en: What is Meta's standard default attribution setting for conversion-optimized ad sets?
q.hi: Conversion-optimized ad sets ke liye Meta ki standard default attribution setting kya hai?
q.mr: Conversion-optimized ad sets साठी Meta ची standard default attribution setting कोणती?

en: 7-day click and 1-day view
28-day click and 28-day view
1-day click only
Last non-direct click, like GA4
hi: 7-day click aur 1-day view
28-day click aur 28-day view
Sirf 1-day click
GA4 jaisa last non-direct click
mr: 7-day click आणि 1-day view
28-day click आणि 28-day view
फक्त 1-day click
GA4 सारखे last non-direct click

exp.en: By default Meta credits conversions within 7 days of a click or 1 day of viewing an ad. This is one reason Meta's numbers differ from GA4 or your store's reports.
exp.hi: Default mein Meta click ke 7 din ya ad view ke 1 din ke andar hui conversions ko credit deta hai. Isliye Meta ke numbers GA4 ya store reports se alag aate hain.
exp.mr: Default नुसार Meta click नंतर 7 दिवसांत किंवा ad पाहिल्यावर 1 दिवसात झालेल्या conversions ला credit देतो. म्हणूनच Meta चे आकडे GA4 किंवा store reports पेक्षा वेगळे येतात.

q.en: You want to know which of 5 opening hooks works best for the same Reel ad. What's the cleanest way to test?
q.hi: Aapko jaanna hai ki same Reel ad ke 5 opening hooks mein se kaunsa best hai. Test karne ka sabse clean tareeka kya hai?
q.mr: एकाच Reel ad च्या 5 opening hooks पैकी कोणता सर्वोत्तम आहे हे जाणून घ्यायचे आहे. Test करण्याचा सर्वात स्वच्छ मार्ग कोणता?

en: Change the hook, audience and offer together each day
Keep everything else the same, vary only the hook, and compare hook rate and CPA
Run each hook to a different country
Post all 5 organically and pick the one with most likes
hi: Har din hook, audience aur offer sab ek saath badlo
Baaki sab same rakho, sirf hook badlo, aur hook rate va CPA compare karo
Har hook ko alag country mein chalao
Paanchon organic post karke sabse zyada likes wala chuno
mr: दररोज hook, audience आणि offer सगळे एकत्र बदला
बाकी सर्व सारखे ठेवा, फक्त hook बदला, आणि hook rate व CPA compare करा
प्रत्येक hook वेगळ्या देशात चालवा
पाचही organic post करा आणि सर्वात जास्त likes असलेला निवडा

exp.en: A fair test changes one variable. Hook rate shows which opening stops the scroll, and CPA confirms it also drives results. Changing several things at once makes the winner impossible to explain.
exp.hi: Fair test mein ek hi variable badalta hai. Hook rate batata hai kaunsi opening scroll rokti hai, aur CPA confirm karta hai ki result bhi laati hai. Ek saath kai cheezein badlo toh winner samajh nahi aata.
exp.mr: Fair test मध्ये एकच variable बदलतो. Hook rate दाखवतो कोणती opening scroll थांबवते, आणि CPA खात्री करतो की ती results ही आणते. अनेक गोष्टी एकत्र बदलल्या तर winner का जिंकला ते कळत नाही.

q.en: Performance marketers often track 'hook rate' (thumb-stop ratio) for video ads. How is it commonly calculated?
q.hi: Performance marketers video ads ke liye 'hook rate' (thumb-stop ratio) track karte hain. Ise aam taur pe kaise calculate karte hain?
q.mr: Performance marketers video ads साठी 'hook rate' (thumb-stop ratio) track करतात. तो साधारण कसा काढतात?

en: Link clicks ÷ impressions
Purchases ÷ link clicks
3-second video plays ÷ impressions
ThruPlays ÷ amount spent
hi: Link clicks ÷ impressions
Purchases ÷ link clicks
3-second video plays ÷ impressions
ThruPlays ÷ amount spent
mr: Link clicks ÷ impressions
Purchases ÷ link clicks
3-second video plays ÷ impressions
ThruPlays ÷ amount spent

exp.en: Hook rate = 3-second plays ÷ impressions, showing how many people stopped scrolling. Link clicks ÷ impressions is link CTR, and purchases ÷ clicks is conversion rate.
exp.hi: Hook rate = 3-second plays ÷ impressions, yaani kitne log scroll rok ke ruke. Link clicks ÷ impressions link CTR hai, aur purchases ÷ clicks conversion rate.
exp.mr: Hook rate = 3-second plays ÷ impressions, म्हणजे किती लोक scroll थांबवून थांबले. Link clicks ÷ impressions म्हणजे link CTR, आणि purchases ÷ clicks म्हणजे conversion rate.

q.en: A Nagpur snack brand sells mainly in Vidarbha. Option A: a celebrity with 5M followers, mostly outside Maharashtra. Option B: 15 local micro-creators with real engagement. For sales, which is smarter?
q.hi: Nagpur ka ek snack brand zyada tar Vidarbha mein bechta hai. Option A: 5M followers wala celebrity, jiske followers zyada tar Maharashtra ke bahar. Option B: 15 local micro-creators jinka engagement real hai. Sales ke liye kya smart hai?
q.mr: Nagpur चा एक snack brand मुख्यतः विदर्भात विकतो. Option A: 5M followers असलेला celebrity, ज्याचे बहुतेक followers महाराष्ट्राबाहेर. Option B: खरे engagement असलेले 15 local micro-creators. Sales साठी कोणता पर्याय हुशार?

en: Option A, because follower count decides sales
Split the budget equally without checking any data
Neither; influencer marketing never works for food
Option B, after checking each creator's audience location and engagement quality
hi: Option A, kyunki followers count se hi sales hoti hai
Bina data dekhe budget barabar baant do
Dono nahi; food ke liye influencer marketing kaam nahi karti
Option B, har creator ki audience location aur engagement quality check karke
mr: Option A, कारण followers च्या संख्येवरून sales ठरते
कोणताही data न पाहता budget समान वाटा
दोन्ही नाही; food साठी influencer marketing चालत नाही
Option B, प्रत्येक creator ची audience location आणि engagement quality तपासून

exp.en: Reach only matters if it's the right audience. Local micro-creators whose followers actually live in Vidarbha usually bring more relevant trust and sales per rupee than a big celebrity with mostly out-of-market followers.
exp.hi: Reach tabhi kaam ki hai jab audience sahi ho. Local micro-creators jinke followers sach mein Vidarbha mein rehte hain, bade celebrity (jiske followers market ke bahar) se har rupaye pe zyada relevant trust aur sales laate hain.
exp.mr: Reach तेव्हाच उपयोगी जेव्हा audience योग्य असते. ज्यांचे followers खरोखर विदर्भात राहतात असे local micro-creators, market बाहेरचे followers असलेल्या मोठ्या celebrity पेक्षा प्रत्येक रुपयामागे जास्त विश्वास आणि sales आणतात.

q.en: What best describes the difference between social monitoring and social listening?
q.hi: Social monitoring aur social listening mein farak sabse achhe se kaunsa option batata hai?
q.mr: Social monitoring आणि social listening मधला फरक कोणता पर्याय सर्वात योग्य सांगतो?

en: Monitoring reacts to individual mentions; listening analyses patterns to guide strategy
Monitoring is only for paid ads; listening is only for organic posts
They are the same; the names differ by tool
Listening means replying to DMs; monitoring means posting content
hi: Monitoring individual mentions pe react karta hai; listening patterns analyse karke strategy guide karta hai
Monitoring sirf paid ads ke liye, listening sirf organic posts ke liye
Dono same hain; bas tool ke hisaab se naam alag
Listening matlab DMs reply karna; monitoring matlab content post karna
mr: Monitoring वैयक्तिक mentions ला प्रतिसाद देते; listening patterns analyse करून strategy ठरवते
Monitoring फक्त paid ads साठी; listening फक्त organic posts साठी
दोन्ही सारखेच; फक्त tool नुसार नावे वेगळी
Listening म्हणजे DMs ला reply; monitoring म्हणजे content post करणे

exp.en: Monitoring is tactical: spotting and responding to specific mentions or complaints. Listening zooms out to sentiment and trends over time, feeding product, content and campaign decisions.
exp.hi: Monitoring tactical hai: specific mentions ya complaints dekh ke respond karna. Listening zoom out karke time ke saath sentiment aur trends dekhta hai, jo product, content aur campaign decisions mein kaam aata hai.
exp.mr: Monitoring tactical आहे: विशिष्ट mentions किंवा तक्रारी पाहून प्रतिसाद देणे. Listening मोठे चित्र पाहते, काळानुसार sentiment आणि trends, जे product, content आणि campaign निर्णयांना मदत करतात.

q.en: With Advantage campaign budget (campaign-level budget), Meta puts 90% of spend into one of your 4 ad sets. Your client insists each ad set must get some spend. What's the right move?
q.hi: Advantage campaign budget (campaign-level budget) mein Meta 4 mein se ek ad set ko 90% spend de raha hai. Client chahta hai har ad set ko kuch spend mile. Sahi move kya hai?
q.mr: Advantage campaign budget (campaign-level budget) मध्ये Meta 4 पैकी एका ad set ला 90% खर्च देत आहे. Client ला प्रत्येक ad set ला काही खर्च हवा आहे. योग्य पाऊल कोणते?

en: Report a bug; budget should always split equally
Understand Meta is chasing the best predicted results, and use ad set spend limits if minimums are truly needed
Pause the winning ad set so others get budget
Duplicate the campaign 4 times with the same settings
hi: Bug report karo; budget hamesha barabar bantna chahiye
Samjho ki Meta best predicted results ke peeche ja raha hai, aur minimum sach mein zaroori ho toh ad set spend limits lagao
Winning ad set pause kar do taaki baakiyon ko budget mile
Same settings ke saath campaign 4 baar duplicate karo
mr: Bug report करा; budget नेहमी समान वाटले पाहिजे
Meta सर्वोत्तम अपेक्षित results कडे जात आहे हे समजून घ्या, आणि minimum खरोखर गरजेचे असल्यास ad set spend limits वापरा
इतरांना budget मिळावे म्हणून जिंकणारा ad set pause करा
त्याच settings सह campaign 4 वेळा duplicate करा

exp.en: Campaign-level budget is designed to move money to where it expects the best results, so uneven spend is normal. Ad set spend limits exist for cases where you genuinely need minimums; pausing the winner usually raises overall CPA.
exp.hi: Campaign-level budget ka design hi hai ki paisa wahan jaaye jahan best results expected hain, toh uneven spend normal hai. Jahan minimum sach mein chahiye wahan ad set spend limits hain; winner pause karne se overall CPA badhta hai.
exp.mr: Campaign-level budget चा उद्देशच पैसा सर्वोत्तम अपेक्षित results कडे वळवणे आहे, त्यामुळे असमान खर्च सामान्य आहे. Minimum खरोखर हवा असल्यास ad set spend limits आहेत; winner pause केल्यास एकूण CPA वाढतो.

q.en: In a placement breakdown, Reels shows the lowest average CPA but gets only 15% of spend. Your junior wants to move all budget to Reels only. What's the expert view?
q.hi: Placement breakdown mein Reels ka average CPA sabse kam hai par use sirf 15% spend mila. Junior saara budget sirf Reels pe daalna chahta hai. Expert view kya hai?
q.mr: Placement breakdown मध्ये Reels चा average CPA सर्वात कमी आहे पण त्याला फक्त 15% खर्च मिळाला. Junior ला सगळे budget फक्त Reels वर टाकायचे आहे. Expert मत काय?

en: Do it; the lowest average CPA placement always scales the same
Turn off Reels, since it got less spend
Be careful: the 'breakdown effect' means more Reels spend may cost more at the margin
Split budget equally across all placements manually
hi: Kar do; sabse kam average CPA wala placement hamesha same scale hota hai
Reels band karo, kyunki use kam spend mila
Dhyaan do: 'breakdown effect' ka matlab Reels pe zyada spend margin pe mehenga ho sakta hai
Saare placements mein manually barabar budget baanto
mr: करा; सर्वात कमी average CPA असलेला placement नेहमी तसाच scale होतो
Reels बंद करा, कारण त्याला कमी खर्च मिळाला
सावध राहा: 'breakdown effect' मुळे Reels वर जास्त खर्च margin वर महाग पडू शकतो
सर्व placements मध्ये manually समान budget वाटा

exp.en: Meta's system optimizes for the lowest marginal cost across the whole ad set. A segment's low average CPA often came from its cheapest few results; pushing more money there can raise its CPA and the overall CPA.
exp.hi: Meta ka system poore ad set ke liye lowest marginal cost optimize karta hai. Kisi segment ka kam average CPA aksar uske sabse saste kuch results se aata hai; wahan zyada paisa daalne se uska aur overall CPA badh sakta hai.
exp.mr: Meta ची system संपूर्ण ad set साठी lowest marginal cost optimize करते. एखाद्या segment चा कमी average CPA अनेकदा त्याच्या सर्वात स्वस्त काही results मुळे असतो; तिथे जास्त पैसा टाकल्यास त्याचा आणि एकूण CPA वाढू शकतो.

q.en: Under ASCI's influencer guidelines, what extra disclosure does a virtual (CGI/AI-generated) influencer need?
q.hi: ASCI influencer guidelines ke hisaab se virtual (CGI/AI-generated) influencer ko kya extra disclosure dena hota hai?
q.mr: ASCI influencer guidelines नुसार virtual (CGI/AI-generated) influencer ला कोणते अतिरिक्त disclosure द्यावे लागते?

en: None, virtual influencers are exempt from ASCI rules
Only the name of the software used to create it
The brand's GST number in every post
That consumers are not interacting with a real human, plus the usual ad label
hi: Kuch nahi, virtual influencers ASCI rules se bahar hain
Sirf use banane wale software ka naam
Har post mein brand ka GST number
Ki consumers kisi real insaan se interact nahi kar rahe, saath mein normal ad label
mr: काही नाही, virtual influencers ना ASCI नियम लागू नाहीत
फक्त ते बनवण्यासाठी वापरलेल्या software चे नाव
प्रत्येक post मध्ये brand चा GST number
Consumers खऱ्या माणसाशी संवाद साधत नाहीत हे, तसेच नेहमीचे ad label

exp.en: ASCI's guidelines say virtual influencers must also disclose that they are not real humans, on top of labelling paid content as ads. They are not exempt just because they aren't people.
exp.hi: ASCI guidelines kehti hain ki virtual influencers ko paid content pe ad label ke alawa yeh bhi batana hoga ki woh real insaan nahi hain. Insaan na hone se woh exempt nahi ho jaate.
exp.mr: ASCI guidelines नुसार virtual influencers नी paid content ला ad label लावण्याबरोबरच ते खरे माणूस नाहीत हेही सांगणे आवश्यक आहे. माणूस नसल्याने ते सूट मिळवत नाहीत.

q.en: Events Manager shows a low Event Match Quality score for your Purchase event sent via Conversions API. What will most directly improve it?
q.hi: Events Manager mein Conversions API se bheje Purchase event ka Event Match Quality score kam hai. Ise sabse seedha kya improve karega?
q.mr: Events Manager मध्ये Conversions API ने पाठवलेल्या Purchase event चा Event Match Quality score कमी आहे. तो सर्वात थेट कशाने सुधारेल?

en: Sending more customer information parameters, e.g. hashed email, phone, fbp/fbc, external_id
Increasing the daily budget
Adding more interests to the targeting
Changing the ad creative to video
hi: Zyada customer information parameters bhejna, jaise hashed email, phone, fbp/fbc, external_id
Daily budget badhana
Targeting mein aur interests jodna
Ad creative ko video mein badalna
mr: जास्त customer information parameters पाठवणे, उदा. hashed email, phone, fbp/fbc, external_id
Daily budget वाढवणे
Targeting मध्ये आणखी interests जोडणे
Ad creative video मध्ये बदलणे

exp.en: Event Match Quality rates how well your events can be matched to Meta accounts, which depends on the customer identifiers you send. Budget, targeting and creative don't change matching.
exp.hi: Event Match Quality batata hai ki aapke events Meta accounts se kitne achhe se match ho rahe hain, jo aapke bheje customer identifiers pe depend karta hai. Budget, targeting, creative se matching nahi badalti.
exp.mr: Event Match Quality म्हणजे तुमचे events Meta accounts शी किती चांगले जुळतात, जे तुम्ही पाठवलेल्या customer identifiers वर अवलंबून असते. Budget, targeting किंवा creative ने matching बदलत नाही.

q.en: An ad set was profitable at ₹5,000/day. You raised it straight to ₹20,000/day and CPA jumped for several days. What most likely happened, and what's better next time?
q.hi: Ek ad set ₹5,000/day pe profitable tha. Aapne seedha ₹20,000/day kar diya aur kuch din CPA badh gaya. Kya hua hoga, aur agli baar kya better hai?
q.mr: एक ad set ₹5,000/दिवस वर profitable होता. तुम्ही तो थेट ₹20,000/दिवस केला आणि काही दिवस CPA वाढला. बहुधा काय झाले, आणि पुढच्या वेळी काय चांगले?

en: Meta penalises accounts that spend more; never raise budgets
A big edit pushed it back into learning and into costlier audiences; scale in steps or add new ad sets
The pixel stopped working because of the budget
Competitors copied the ad; change the page name
hi: Meta zyada spend karne walon ko penalise karta hai; budget kabhi mat badhao
Bade edit ne use wapas learning mein aur mehngi audience mein daal diya; step-by-step scale karo ya naye ad sets jodo
Budget ki wajah se pixel band ho gaya
Competitors ne ad copy kar liya; page ka naam badlo
mr: Meta जास्त खर्च करणाऱ्यांना शिक्षा करतो; budget कधीच वाढवू नका
मोठ्या edit मुळे ad set पुन्हा learning मध्ये आणि महाग audience मध्ये गेला; टप्प्याटप्प्याने scale करा किंवा नवे ad sets जोडा
Budget मुळे pixel बंद पडला
Competitors नी ad copy केली; page चे नाव बदला

exp.en: A large budget change counts as a significant edit and can restart learning, and more spend also has to reach less-responsive people. Gradual increases or new ad sets usually protect CPA better.
exp.hi: Bada budget change significant edit maana jaata hai aur learning restart kar sakta hai, aur zyada spend ko kam-responsive logon tak bhi jaana padta hai. Dheere-dheere badhana ya naye ad sets banana CPA ko better bachata hai.
exp.mr: मोठा budget बदल significant edit मानला जातो आणि learning पुन्हा सुरू करू शकतो, तसेच जास्त खर्च कमी प्रतिसाद देणाऱ्या लोकांपर्यंतही जातो. हळूहळू वाढ किंवा नवे ad sets CPA चांगले टिकवतात.

q.en: A Jaipur wedding-decor studio wants content that keeps bringing leads for months, from couples planning 6-12 months ahead. Which platform should it prioritise alongside Instagram?
q.hi: Jaipur ka ek wedding-decor studio aisa content chahta hai jo mahino tak leads laaye, un couples se jo 6-12 mahine pehle plan karte hain. Instagram ke saath kaunsa platform prioritise kare?
q.mr: Jaipur मधील एका wedding-decor studio ला असे content हवे जे महिनोंमहिने leads आणेल, 6-12 महिने आधी plan करणाऱ्या couples कडून. Instagram सोबत कोणत्या platform ला प्राधान्य द्यावे?

en: X, because posts trend quickly
Snapchat, because snaps disappear
Pinterest, because people search and save ideas while planning
LinkedIn, because couples look for decorators there
hi: X, kyunki posts jaldi trend hote hain
Snapchat, kyunki snaps gayab ho jaate hain
Pinterest, kyunki log planning ke waqt ideas search aur save karte hain
LinkedIn, kyunki couples wahan decorators dhoondhte hain
mr: X, कारण posts पटकन trend होतात
Snapchat, कारण snaps गायब होतात
Pinterest, कारण लोक planning करताना ideas शोधतात आणि save करतात
LinkedIn, कारण couples तिथे decorators शोधतात

exp.en: Pinterest is search- and planning-driven, and Pins linking to your site can surface for months, which fits long wedding planning cycles. X content is fast-moving and short-lived.
exp.hi: Pinterest search aur planning pe chalta hai, aur website link wale Pins mahino tak dikh sakte hain, jo lambi wedding planning ke liye perfect hai. X ka content tez aur short-lived hota hai.
exp.mr: Pinterest search आणि planning वर चालते, आणि website link असलेले Pins महिनोंमहिने दिसू शकतात, जे लग्नाच्या दीर्घ planning ला जुळते. X वरील content वेगवान आणि अल्पायुषी असते.

q.en: A viral video on X claims a foreign object was found in your packaged food. Mentions are exploding. What should the brand do first?
q.hi: X pe ek viral video claim karta hai ki aapke packaged food mein koi cheez mili. Mentions tezi se badh rahe hain. Brand ko pehle kya karna chahiye?
q.mr: X वर एका viral video मध्ये दावा आहे की तुमच्या packaged food मध्ये परकी वस्तू सापडली. Mentions झपाट्याने वाढत आहेत. Brand ने आधी काय करावे?

en: Stay silent until the trend dies down
Reply that the video is fake before checking anything
Keep the scheduled festive offer posts running as normal
Acknowledge quickly, pause promo posts, contact the customer, investigate and share factual updates
hi: Trend thanda hone tak chup raho
Kuch check kiye bina reply karo ki video fake hai
Scheduled festive offer posts normal chalne do
Jaldi acknowledge karo, promo posts pause karo, customer se contact karo, investigate karo aur factual updates do
mr: Trend थंड होईपर्यंत गप्प राहा
काहीही न तपासता video fake आहे असे reply करा
Scheduled festive offer posts नेहमीप्रमाणे चालू ठेवा
लवकर दखल घ्या, promo posts थांबवा, ग्राहकाशी संपर्क करा, चौकशी करा आणि तथ्यपूर्ण updates द्या

exp.en: In a crisis, speed and honesty matter: acknowledge, pause tone-deaf promotions, investigate and update with facts. Calling it fake without evidence or staying silent usually makes the story bigger.
exp.hi: Crisis mein speed aur honesty zaroori hai: acknowledge karo, galat time pe promotions roko, investigate karke facts ke saath update do. Bina saboot fake bolna ya chup rehna story ko aur bada kar deta hai.
exp.mr: संकटात वेग आणि प्रामाणिकपणा महत्त्वाचा: दखल घ्या, अयोग्य वेळचे promotions थांबवा, चौकशी करून तथ्यांसह update द्या. पुराव्याशिवाय fake म्हणणे किंवा गप्प राहणे प्रकरण अधिक मोठे करते.

q.en: A Pune B2B SaaS startup's LinkedIn company page posts get 200-300 impressions each, with almost no engagement. What is the best organic fix?
q.hi: Pune ke ek B2B SaaS startup ke LinkedIn company page posts ko 200-300 impressions hi milte hain, engagement lagbhag zero. Best organic fix kya hai?
q.mr: Pune मधील एका B2B SaaS startup च्या LinkedIn company page posts ना फक्त 200-300 impressions मिळतात, engagement जवळपास शून्य. सर्वोत्तम organic उपाय कोणता?

en: Have the founder and team post useful insights from their own profiles, and reshare selectively
Post the same product brochure daily from the company page
Add 30 hashtags and tag 50 random people per post
Only post job openings on the page
hi: Founder aur team apne profiles se useful insights post karein, aur page selectively reshare kare
Company page se roz wahi product brochure post karo
Har post mein 30 hashtags aur 50 random logon ko tag karo
Page pe sirf job openings post karo
mr: Founder आणि team ने स्वतःच्या profiles वरून उपयोगी insights post करावेत, आणि page ने निवडकपणे reshare करावे
Company page वरून रोज तेच product brochure post करा
प्रत्येक post मध्ये 30 hashtags आणि 50 random लोकांना tag करा
Page वर फक्त job openings post करा

exp.en: On LinkedIn, people engage more with people than with logos, so founder and employee posts usually reach and engage far more than company-page posts. Mass tagging strangers looks spammy and can hurt reach.
exp.hi: LinkedIn pe log logos se zyada insaano se engage karte hain, isliye founder aur employee posts company page se kaafi zyada reach aur engagement laate hain. Anjaan logon ko mass tag karna spammy lagta hai aur reach bigaad sakta hai.
exp.mr: LinkedIn वर लोक logos पेक्षा माणसांशी जास्त engage होतात, म्हणून founder आणि employee posts company page पेक्षा खूप जास्त reach आणि engagement मिळवतात. अनोळखी लोकांना mass tag करणे spammy दिसते आणि reach कमी करू शकते.

q.en: In Meta's Advantage+ audience, you enter an age range of 25-35 and some interests. How are these treated?
q.hi: Meta ke Advantage+ audience mein aapne 25-35 age range aur kuch interests daale. Inhe kaise treat kiya jaata hai?
q.mr: Meta च्या Advantage+ audience मध्ये तुम्ही 25-35 age range आणि काही interests टाकले. यांना कसे वागवले जाते?

en: As strict limits the system can never go beyond
As suggestions; hard limits only apply through audience controls like location, minimum age and exclusions
They are ignored completely, with no effect on delivery
They switch the campaign to manual bidding
hi: Strict limits ki tarah, system kabhi bahar nahi jaata
Suggestions ki tarah; hard limits sirf audience controls (location, minimum age, exclusions) se lagte hain
Poori tarah ignore hote hain, delivery pe koi asar nahi
Campaign manual bidding pe chala jaata hai
mr: कडक मर्यादा म्हणून, system कधीच बाहेर जात नाही
सूचना (suggestions) म्हणून; कडक मर्यादा फक्त audience controls (location, minimum age, exclusions) ने लागतात
पूर्णपणे ignore होतात, delivery वर काही परिणाम नाही
Campaign manual bidding वर जातो

exp.en: Advantage+ audience uses your inputs as a starting signal and may expand beyond them if it predicts better results. If something must be a hard rule (e.g. 18+ only, excluding customers), set it in audience controls.
exp.hi: Advantage+ audience aapke inputs ko starting signal maanta hai aur better results dikhne pe unse aage badh sakta hai. Jo cheez hard rule honi chahiye (jaise sirf 18+, customers exclude), use audience controls mein set karo.
exp.mr: Advantage+ audience तुमचे inputs सुरुवातीचा signal म्हणून वापरते आणि चांगले results अपेक्षित असल्यास त्यापलीकडे जाऊ शकते. जे कडक नियम असायला हवे (उदा. फक्त 18+, customers वगळणे) ते audience controls मध्ये ठेवा.

q.en: A jewellery D2C brand's Lookalike built from 'all website visitors' brings cheap clicks but few buyers. Which seed will most likely give better Lookalike results?
q.hi: Ek jewellery D2C brand ka 'all website visitors' se bana Lookalike saste clicks laata hai par buyers kam. Kaunsa seed better Lookalike results dega?
q.mr: एका jewellery D2C brand चा 'all website visitors' वरून बनवलेला Lookalike स्वस्त clicks आणतो पण buyers कमी. कोणता seed चांगले Lookalike results देईल?

en: People who liked any post in the last 2 years
A list of Instagram followers of competitor brands
High-value repeat purchasers from the customer list
Everyone who watched 3 seconds of any video
hi: Pichhle 2 saal mein kisi bhi post ko like karne wale
Competitor brands ke Instagram followers ki list
Customer list se high-value repeat purchasers
Kisi bhi video ke 3 second dekhne wale sab log
mr: गेल्या 2 वर्षांत कोणतीही post like करणारे
Competitor brands च्या Instagram followers ची list
Customer list मधील high-value repeat purchasers
कोणत्याही video चे 3 सेकंद पाहणारे सर्वजण

exp.en: A Lookalike copies the traits of its seed. Seeding with your best customers teaches Meta what a valuable buyer looks like, while broad seeds like all visitors or 3-second viewers find people who browse but don't buy. You also can't upload competitors' followers.
exp.hi: Lookalike apne seed ke traits copy karta hai. Best customers ka seed Meta ko sikhata hai ki valuable buyer kaisa dikhta hai, jabki all visitors ya 3-second viewers jaise broad seeds sirf browse karne walon ko laate hain. Competitors ke followers upload bhi nahi kar sakte.
exp.mr: Lookalike आपल्या seed चे गुणधर्म copy करतो. सर्वोत्तम customers चा seed Meta ला मौल्यवान buyer कसा असतो हे शिकवतो, तर all visitors किंवा 3-second viewers सारखे broad seeds फक्त browse करणारे आणतात. Competitors चे followers upload करताही येत नाहीत.

q.en: An account runs 12 ad sets with similar interest audiences in the same city, each at ₹500/day. CPMs are high and most are stuck in learning. What's the best fix?
q.hi: Ek account same city mein milti-julti interest audiences ke 12 ad sets chala raha hai, har ek ₹500/day pe. CPM high hain aur zyada tar learning mein atke hain. Best fix kya hai?
q.mr: एक account एकाच शहरात सारख्या interest audiences चे 12 ad sets चालवत आहे, प्रत्येकी ₹500/दिवस. CPM जास्त आहेत आणि बहुतेक learning मध्ये अडकले आहेत. सर्वोत्तम उपाय कोणता?

en: Add 12 more ad sets to find new winners
Lower each ad set to ₹250/day to save money
Add even narrower interests to each ad set
Consolidate into fewer ad sets with broader audiences so each exits learning
hi: Naye winners dhoondhne ke liye 12 aur ad sets jodo
Paise bachane ke liye har ad set ₹250/day kar do
Har ad set mein aur narrow interests jodo
Kam ad sets mein consolidate karo broader audiences ke saath taaki har ek learning se nikle
mr: नवे winners शोधण्यासाठी आणखी 12 ad sets जोडा
पैसे वाचवण्यासाठी प्रत्येक ad set ₹250/दिवस करा
प्रत्येक ad set मध्ये आणखी narrow interests जोडा
कमी ad sets मध्ये broader audiences सह एकत्र करा म्हणजे प्रत्येक learning मधून बाहेर पडेल

exp.en: Overlapping ad sets compete for the same people and split data, so none gets enough conversions to learn. Fewer, larger ad sets pool the signal and usually lower costs.
exp.hi: Overlapping ad sets same logon ke liye aapas mein compete karte hain aur data baant dete hain, isliye kisi ko bhi seekhne laayak conversions nahi milte. Kam aur bade ad sets signal ek jagah laate hain aur cost aksar kam karte hain.
exp.mr: Overlap होणारे ad sets त्याच लोकांसाठी आपसात स्पर्धा करतात आणि data विभागतात, त्यामुळे कुणालाच शिकण्याइतके conversions मिळत नाहीत. कमी, मोठे ad sets signal एकत्र करतात आणि खर्च सहसा कमी करतात.

q.en: Your 12-minute YouTube tutorial loses about half its viewers in the first 30 seconds, during a long channel intro and sponsor mention. What's the best fix?
q.hi: Aapka 12-minute YouTube tutorial pehle 30 second mein, lambe channel intro aur sponsor mention ke dauraan, lagbhag aadhe viewers kho deta hai. Best fix kya hai?
q.mr: तुमचा 12 मिनिटांचा YouTube tutorial पहिल्या 30 सेकंदांत, लांब channel intro आणि sponsor mention दरम्यान, सुमारे अर्धे viewers गमावतो. सर्वोत्तम उपाय कोणता?

en: Open by confirming the promise of the title, show the payoff early, and move the intro/sponsor later
Make the video 30 minutes long to raise watch time
Add more tags in the description
Post the video at midnight when there is less competition
hi: Shuru mein title ka promise confirm karo, payoff jaldi dikhao, aur intro/sponsor baad mein le jao
Watch time badhane ke liye video 30 minute ka kar do
Description mein aur tags jodo
Kam competition ke liye video midnight ko post karo
mr: सुरुवातीलाच title चे वचन पक्के करा, payoff लवकर दाखवा, आणि intro/sponsor नंतर हलवा
Watch time वाढवण्यासाठी video 30 मिनिटांचा करा
Description मध्ये आणखी tags जोडा
कमी स्पर्धेसाठी video मध्यरात्री post करा

exp.en: Viewers clicked for what the title and thumbnail promised; a long intro makes them leave. Delivering value quickly improves retention, which helps YouTube recommend the video. More tags or odd timing won't fix an early drop-off.
exp.hi: Viewers title-thumbnail ke promise ke liye aaye the; lamba intro unhe bhaga deta hai. Jaldi value dene se retention sudharta hai, jisse YouTube video recommend karta hai. Zyada tags ya ajeeb timing early drop-off theek nahi karte.
exp.mr: Viewers title-thumbnail च्या वचनासाठी आले होते; लांब intro त्यांना घालवतो. लवकर value दिल्यास retention सुधारतो, ज्यामुळे YouTube video recommend करते. जास्त tags किंवा वेगळी वेळ early drop-off सुधारत नाहीत.

q.en: Your Meta retargeting campaign (cart abandoners + past buyers) reports 12x ROAS. The CFO wants to triple its budget. What should you check first?
q.hi: Aapka Meta retargeting campaign (cart abandoners + past buyers) 12x ROAS report karta hai. CFO iska budget teen guna karna chahte hain. Pehle kya check karna chahiye?
q.mr: तुमचा Meta retargeting campaign (cart abandoners + past buyers) 12x ROAS दाखवतो. CFO ला त्याचे budget तिप्पट करायचे आहे. आधी काय तपासावे?

en: Nothing; 12x ROAS proves it deserves more budget
How many sales are truly incremental, e.g. with a holdout or conversion lift test
Whether the ad has enough emojis
Whether competitors also run retargeting
hi: Kuch nahi; 12x ROAS saabit karta hai ki budget milna chahiye
Kitni sales sach mein incremental hain, jaise holdout ya conversion lift test se
Ad mein kaafi emojis hain ya nahi
Competitors bhi retargeting chalate hain ya nahi
mr: काही नाही; 12x ROAS सिद्ध करतो की जास्त budget द्यावे
किती sales खरोखर incremental आहेत, उदा. holdout किंवा conversion lift test ने
Ad मध्ये पुरेसे emojis आहेत का
Competitors ही retargeting चालवतात का

exp.en: Retargeting audiences are already close to buying, so attribution often credits ads for sales that would have happened anyway. A lift or holdout test shows the real extra sales, and the audience is small, so tripling spend mostly raises frequency.
exp.hi: Retargeting audience pehle se khareedne ke kareeb hoti hai, isliye attribution un sales ka credit bhi ads ko de deta hai jo waise bhi hoti. Lift/holdout test asli extra sales dikhata hai, aur audience chhoti hai toh teen guna spend zyada tar frequency hi badhata hai.
exp.mr: Retargeting audience आधीच खरेदीच्या जवळ असते, त्यामुळे attribution अशा sales चे credit ही ads ना देते ज्या तशाही झाल्या असत्या. Lift/holdout test खरी अतिरिक्त sales दाखवतो, आणि audience लहान असल्याने तिप्पट खर्च मुख्यतः frequency वाढवतो.

q.en: An Indian fashion influencer has 200K followers but 0.3% engagement, sudden follower spikes, and generic comments ('Nice pic') from foreign accounts. What does this most likely indicate?
q.hi: Ek Indian fashion influencer ke 200K followers hain par engagement 0.3%, achanak follower spikes, aur foreign accounts se generic comments ('Nice pic'). Iska sabse sambhavit matlab kya hai?
q.mr: एका Indian fashion influencer चे 200K followers आहेत पण engagement 0.3%, अचानक follower spikes, आणि परदेशी accounts कडून generic comments ('Nice pic'). याचा बहुधा अर्थ काय?

en: A highly loyal audience that prefers not to comment
A creator who is great for local Indian campaigns
Likely inflated or fake followers; ask for audience insights before paying
Normal behaviour for any account above 100K
hi: Bahut loyal audience jo comment karna pasand nahi karti
Local Indian campaigns ke liye perfect creator
Shayad inflated ya fake followers; pay karne se pehle audience insights maango
100K se upar ke har account ka normal behaviour
mr: खूप निष्ठावान audience जी comment करणे टाळते
Local Indian campaigns साठी उत्तम creator
बहुधा फुगवलेले किंवा fake followers; पैसे देण्यापूर्वी audience insights मागा
100K वरील प्रत्येक account चे नेहमीचे वर्तन

exp.en: Very low engagement, sudden follower jumps and generic comments from out-of-market accounts are classic signs of bought followers or engagement pods. Ask for screenshots of audience location and engagement data before signing.
exp.hi: Bahut kam engagement, achanak follower jumps aur market ke bahar ke accounts se generic comments khareede gaye followers ya engagement pods ke classic signs hain. Sign karne se pehle audience location aur engagement data ke screenshots maango.
exp.mr: खूप कमी engagement, अचानक follower वाढ आणि market बाहेरील accounts कडून generic comments ही विकत घेतलेल्या followers किंवा engagement pods ची ठळक लक्षणे आहेत. करार करण्यापूर्वी audience location आणि engagement data चे screenshots मागा.

q.en: What are Meta 'partnership ads' (formerly branded content ads)?
q.hi: Meta 'partnership ads' (pehle branded content ads) kya hote hain?
q.mr: Meta 'partnership ads' (पूर्वीचे branded content ads) म्हणजे काय?

en: Ads that two brands must fund 50-50
Free ads Meta gives to verified creators
Ads that can only run on Facebook Marketplace
Ads that run with the creator's handle alongside the brand, with the creator's permission
hi: Aise ads jinhe do brands ko 50-50 fund karna padta hai
Verified creators ko Meta ke free ads
Aise ads jo sirf Facebook Marketplace pe chal sakte hain
Aise ads jo creator ke handle ke saath brand ke saath chalte hain, creator ki permission se
mr: असे ads ज्यांना दोन brands नी 50-50 पैसे द्यावे लागतात
Verified creators ना Meta ने दिलेले free ads
फक्त Facebook Marketplace वर चालणारे ads
Creator च्या परवानगीने brand सोबत creator चा handle दाखवत चालणारे ads

exp.en: Partnership ads show the creator's identity together with the brand, so the ad keeps the creator's credibility while the brand controls targeting and budget. The creator must grant permission.
exp.hi: Partnership ads mein creator ki identity brand ke saath dikhti hai, toh ad ko creator ki credibility milti hai aur targeting-budget brand control karta hai. Creator ki permission zaroori hai.
exp.mr: Partnership ads मध्ये creator ची ओळख brand सोबत दिसते, त्यामुळे ad ला creator ची विश्वासार्हता मिळते आणि targeting-budget brand नियंत्रित करतो. Creator ची परवानगी आवश्यक असते.

q.en: A D2C apparel brand spends ₹3L/month across 25 interest-based ad sets at about ₹400/day each, all 'Learning limited', with 3 creatives total. Which restructure is most likely to improve results?
q.hi: Ek D2C apparel brand ₹3L/month 25 interest-based ad sets mein kharch karta hai, har ek lagbhag ₹400/day, sab 'Learning limited', aur total sirf 3 creatives. Kaunsa restructure results sudharega?
q.mr: एक D2C apparel brand ₹3L/महिना 25 interest-based ad sets मध्ये खर्च करतो, प्रत्येकी सुमारे ₹400/दिवस, सगळे 'Learning limited', आणि एकूण फक्त 3 creatives. कोणता restructure results सुधारण्याची सर्वात जास्त शक्यता?

en: Consolidate into 1-2 broad or Advantage+ sales campaigns and invest in many more creative variations
Split into 50 ad sets so each interest is tested separately
Keep the structure but cut budget to ₹1L/month
Switch every ad set to Traffic to get cheaper clicks
hi: 1-2 broad ya Advantage+ sales campaigns mein consolidate karo aur kaafi zyada creative variations banao
50 ad sets mein split karo taaki har interest alag test ho
Structure same rakho par budget ₹1L/month kar do
Saste clicks ke liye har ad set Traffic pe daal do
mr: 1-2 broad किंवा Advantage+ sales campaigns मध्ये एकत्र करा आणि खूप जास्त creative variations बनवा
50 ad sets मध्ये विभागा म्हणजे प्रत्येक interest वेगळा test होईल
Structure तसेच ठेवा पण budget ₹1L/महिना करा
स्वस्त clicks साठी प्रत्येक ad set Traffic वर टाका

exp.en: Fragmented budgets starve learning, and with broad delivery the creative does most of the targeting. Consolidating gives the algorithm enough conversions, and more creative variety gives it more angles to find buyers. Traffic optimizes for clicks, not purchases.
exp.hi: Bikhra budget learning ko bhookha rakhta hai, aur broad delivery mein creative hi zyada tar targeting karta hai. Consolidate karne se algorithm ko kaafi conversions milte hain, aur zyada creatives se buyers dhoondhne ke zyada angles. Traffic clicks ke liye optimize karta hai, purchases ke liye nahi.
exp.mr: विखुरलेले budget learning ला उपाशी ठेवते, आणि broad delivery मध्ये creative च बहुतेक targeting करते. एकत्र केल्याने algorithm ला पुरेसे conversions मिळतात, आणि जास्त creatives मुळे buyers शोधण्याचे जास्त मार्ग. Traffic clicks साठी optimize करतो, purchases साठी नाही.

q.en: During Diwali week, a gifting brand's Meta CPA rises 40%. CPMs are up sharply, while CTR and conversion rate are stable. What's the smartest response?
q.hi: Diwali week mein ek gifting brand ka Meta CPA 40% badh gaya. CPM tezi se upar hain, jabki CTR aur conversion rate stable hain. Sabse smart response kya hai?
q.mr: दिवाळी आठवड्यात एका gifting brand चा Meta CPA 40% वाढला. CPM झपाट्याने वाढले आहेत, तर CTR आणि conversion rate स्थिर आहेत. सर्वात हुशार प्रतिसाद कोणता?

en: Kill all campaigns; the creative has clearly stopped working
Accept festive auction costs; judge on margin and total sales, and prepare creatives earlier next year
Change all audiences and creatives immediately
Move the whole budget to organic posting for the week
hi: Saare campaigns band karo; creative saaf taur pe fail ho gaya
Festive auction cost samjho; margin aur total sales pe judge karo, agle saal creatives pehle taiyaar karo
Turant saari audiences aur creatives badal do
Hafte bhar ka poora budget organic posting pe laga do
mr: सगळे campaigns बंद करा; creative स्पष्टपणे चालेनासे झाले
सणासुदीचा auction खर्च स्वीकारा; margin आणि एकूण sales वर मूल्यांकन करा, पुढच्या वर्षी creatives आधी तयार करा
लगेच सगळ्या audiences आणि creatives बदला
आठवडाभराचे पूर्ण budget organic posting वर लावा

exp.en: Stable CTR and conversion rate mean the ads still work; higher CPMs from festive competition explain the CPA rise. Panic changes would reset learning during peak demand. Judge on profit and total sales, and prepare earlier next time.
exp.hi: Stable CTR aur conversion rate ka matlab ads abhi bhi kaam kar rahe hain; festive competition se badhe CPM hi CPA badhne ki wajah hain. Panic changes peak demand mein learning reset kar denge. Profit aur total sales pe judge karo, aur agli baar pehle tayari karo.
exp.mr: स्थिर CTR आणि conversion rate म्हणजे ads अजूनही चालत आहेत; सणासुदीच्या स्पर्धेमुळे वाढलेले CPM हेच CPA वाढीचे कारण. घाबरून केलेले बदल peak demand च्या वेळी learning reset करतील. नफा आणि एकूण sales वर मूल्यांकन करा, आणि पुढच्या वेळी आधी तयारी करा.

q.en: Meta Ads Manager shows 120 purchases this week, but Shopify recorded 80 orders from all sources. Which explanation and action are most sensible?
q.hi: Meta Ads Manager is hafte 120 purchases dikha raha hai, par Shopify ne saare sources se 80 orders record kiye. Kaunsa explanation aur action sabse sahi hai?
q.mr: Meta Ads Manager या आठवड्यात 120 purchases दाखवतो, पण Shopify ने सर्व sources मिळून 80 orders नोंदवल्या. कोणते स्पष्टीकरण आणि पाऊल सर्वात योग्य?

en: Shopify is wrong; always trust the ad platform
Meta is committing fraud; stop all ads
Check for duplicate events first (e.g. purchase firing on thank-you page reloads), then compare using the same windows
Ignore it; tracking differences don't matter
hi: Shopify galat hai; hamesha ad platform pe bharosa karo
Meta fraud kar raha hai; saare ads band karo
Pehle duplicate events check karo (jaise thank-you page reload pe purchase fire hona), phir same windows se compare karo
Ignore karo; tracking ke farak se kuch nahi hota
mr: Shopify चुकीचे आहे; नेहमी ad platform वर विश्वास ठेवा
Meta fraud करत आहे; सगळे ads बंद करा
आधी duplicate events तपासा (उदा. thank-you page reload वर purchase fire होणे), मग समान windows वापरून compare करा
दुर्लक्ष करा; tracking मधील फरकाने काही होत नाही

exp.en: Ads cannot drive more purchases than your store actually received, so 120 attributed vs 80 total orders strongly suggests double-firing or missing deduplication. Fix tracking first, then compare using matching attribution windows and dates.
exp.hi: Ads store ke asli orders se zyada purchases nahi la sakte, isliye 120 attributed vs 80 total orders double-firing ya missing deduplication ki taraf strong ishaara hai. Pehle tracking theek karo, phir matching attribution windows aur dates se compare karo.
exp.mr: Ads मुळे store ला प्रत्यक्ष मिळालेल्या orders पेक्षा जास्त purchases होऊ शकत नाहीत, त्यामुळे 120 attributed विरुद्ध एकूण 80 orders हे double-firing किंवा deduplication नसल्याचे ठळक लक्षण आहे. आधी tracking दुरुस्त करा, मग जुळणाऱ्या attribution windows आणि dates ने compare करा.

q.en: A Pune coaching institute gets Meta leads at ₹40 each, but only 1% become admissions. The CRM tracks which leads were qualified and which enrolled. What's the best next step?
q.hi: Pune ke ek coaching institute ko Meta leads ₹40 each pe milte hain, par sirf 1% admission lete hain. CRM track karta hai kaunse leads qualified the aur kaunse enroll hue. Best next step kya hai?
q.mr: Pune मधील एका coaching institute ला Meta leads प्रत्येकी ₹40 ला मिळतात, पण फक्त 1% admission घेतात. CRM मध्ये कोणते leads qualified होते आणि कोणी enroll केले ते नोंदवले जाते. पुढचे सर्वोत्तम पाऊल कोणते?

en: Cut the form to only name and phone to lower cost further
Pause Meta and rely only on walk-ins
Target a wider age range to get more leads
Send CRM stages back to Meta (via Conversions API) and optimize for qualified or converted leads
hi: Cost aur kam karne ke liye form mein sirf naam aur phone rakho
Meta pause karke sirf walk-ins pe depend raho
Zyada leads ke liye wider age range target karo
CRM stages Meta ko (Conversions API se) wapas bhejo aur qualified ya converted leads ke liye optimize karo
mr: खर्च आणखी कमी करण्यासाठी form मध्ये फक्त नाव आणि phone ठेवा
Meta थांबवा आणि फक्त walk-ins वर अवलंबून राहा
जास्त leads साठी wider age range target करा
CRM stages Meta ला (Conversions API ने) परत पाठवा आणि qualified किंवा converted leads साठी optimize करा

exp.en: If Meta only sees form fills, it finds more cheap form-fillers. Feeding back CRM outcomes lets it learn which leads actually enrol (e.g. Meta's conversion leads optimization), usually raising cost per lead but lowering cost per admission.
exp.hi: Agar Meta ko sirf form fills dikhte hain toh woh aur saste form-fillers dhoondhta hai. CRM outcomes wapas bhejne se woh seekhta hai kaunse leads sach mein enroll karte hain (jaise Meta ka conversion leads optimization), jisse cost per lead badh sakta hai par cost per admission ghat-ta hai.
exp.mr: Meta ला फक्त form fills दिसत असतील तर तो आणखी स्वस्त form-fillers शोधतो. CRM outcomes परत पाठवल्याने तो शिकतो कोणते leads खरोखर enroll करतात (उदा. Meta चे conversion leads optimization), त्यामुळे cost per lead वाढू शकतो पण cost per admission कमी होतो.

q.en: A Pune café's Reels using trending audio get 200K views, but insights show most viewers are outside Maharashtra and footfall hasn't changed. What's the best content strategy shift?
q.hi: Pune ke ek café ke trending audio wale Reels ko 200K views milte hain, par insights dikhate hain ki zyada viewers Maharashtra ke bahar hain aur footfall nahi badha. Best content strategy shift kya hai?
q.mr: Pune मधील एका café च्या trending audio वाल्या Reels ना 200K views मिळतात, पण insights दाखवतात की बहुतेक viewers महाराष्ट्राबाहेर आहेत आणि footfall बदलला नाही. सर्वोत्तम content strategy बदल कोणता?

en: Make local content (area names, local creators, Marathi/Hindi hooks) and track DMs, saves and visits
Chase even bigger national trends to reach 1M views
Stop Reels and post only static menu images
Buy views from a panel to boost the algorithm
hi: Local content banao (area names, local creators, Marathi/Hindi hooks, location tags) aur saves, DMs va visits track karo
1M views ke liye aur bade national trends ke peeche jao
Reels band karke sirf static menu images post karo
Algorithm boost karne ke liye panel se views khareedo
mr: स्थानिक content बनवा (भागांची नावे, local creators, मराठी/हिंदी hooks, location tags) आणि saves, DMs व visits track करा
1M views साठी आणखी मोठ्या national trends मागे जा
Reels बंद करून फक्त static menu images post करा
Algorithm boost करण्यासाठी panel कडून views विकत घ्या

exp.en: Views from people who can't visit are vanity. Local signals (places, language, local collabs) help reach nearby people, and business metrics like DMs, saves and visits show real impact. Bought views damage account quality.
exp.hi: Jo log aa hi nahi sakte unke views vanity hain. Local signals (jagah, bhaasha, local collabs) aas-paas ke logon tak pahunchate hain, aur DMs, saves, visits jaise business metrics asli impact dikhate hain. Khareede views account quality kharab karte hain.
exp.mr: जे लोक येऊच शकत नाहीत त्यांचे views म्हणजे vanity. स्थानिक signals (ठिकाणे, भाषा, local collabs) जवळच्या लोकांपर्यंत पोहोचवतात, आणि DMs, saves, visits सारखे business metrics खरा परिणाम दाखवतात. विकत घेतलेले views account quality बिघडवतात.

q.en: A brand sends free products (no cash) to 50 micro-influencers, who post glowing reviews without any disclosure. Under ASCI guidelines, what is the position?
q.hi: Ek brand 50 micro-influencers ko free products (bina cash) bhejta hai, aur woh bina disclosure ke tareefon bhare reviews post karte hain. ASCI guidelines ke hisaab se kya position hai?
q.mr: एक brand 50 micro-influencers ना free products (रोख नाही) पाठवतो, आणि ते कोणतेही disclosure न देता कौतुकाचे reviews post करतात. ASCI guidelines नुसार स्थिती काय?

en: No disclosure needed because no money was paid
Disclosure is needed: free products are a material connection, and the brand should ensure it happens
Only influencers above 1 lakh followers must disclose
Disclosure is needed only if the review is negative
hi: Disclosure ki zaroorat nahi kyunki paisa nahi diya
Disclosure zaroori hai: free products material connection hain, aur brand ko ensure karna chahiye ki disclosure ho
Sirf 1 lakh se zyada followers wale influencers ko disclose karna hai
Disclosure sirf tab chahiye jab review negative ho
mr: पैसे दिले नाहीत म्हणून disclosure ची गरज नाही
Disclosure आवश्यक आहे: free products हे material connection आहे, आणि brand ने disclosure होईल याची खात्री करावी
फक्त 1 लाखांपेक्षा जास्त followers असलेल्या influencers नी disclose करावे
Review negative असेल तरच disclosure लागते

exp.en: ASCI treats any material connection, including free products, gifts or trips, as requiring disclosure, whatever the follower count. Brands are also expected to make sure the influencers they work with disclose properly.
exp.hi: ASCI kisi bhi material connection, jaise free products, gifts ya trips, pe disclosure maangta hai, followers kitne bhi hon. Brands se bhi ummeed hai ki woh ensure karein ki unke influencers theek se disclose karein.
exp.mr: ASCI नुसार कोणतेही material connection, जसे free products, gifts किंवा trips, असल्यास followers कितीही असले तरी disclosure आवश्यक आहे. Brands नीही त्यांच्या influencers नी योग्य disclosure दिल्याची खात्री करणे अपेक्षित आहे.

q.en: After a 20% price hike, social listening shows negative sentiment jumping from 8% to 35%, mostly about 'same pack, higher price'. Sales dipped slightly. What's the best response?
q.hi: 20% price hike ke baad social listening dikhata hai ki negative sentiment 8% se 35% ho gaya, zyada tar 'same pack, zyada price' ko lekar. Sales thodi giri. Best response kya hai?
q.mr: 20% किंमत वाढीनंतर social listening दाखवते की negative sentiment 8% वरून 35% झाले, बहुतेक 'तोच pack, जास्त किंमत' याबद्दल. Sales थोडी घटली. सर्वोत्तम प्रतिसाद कोणता?

en: Delete negative comments and restrict replies
Immediately reverse the price without analysis
Explain the reason openly, share insights with pricing teams, and consider a smaller value pack
Run more ads with the same message to drown out complaints
hi: Negative comments delete karo aur replies restrict karo
Bina analysis turant price wapas le lo
Transparently wajah samjhao, insight product/pricing teams ko do, aur chhote pack jaise value options socho
Complaints dabane ke liye same message ke saath aur ads chalao
mr: Negative comments delete करा आणि replies बंद करा
कोणतेही analysis न करता लगेच किंमत मागे घ्या
कारण पारदर्शकपणे सांगा, insight product/pricing teams ला द्या, आणि लहान pack सारखे value पर्याय विचारात घ्या
तक्रारी दाबण्यासाठी त्याच message सह आणखी ads चालवा

exp.en: Listening is useful only if insights reach decision-makers. Honest communication plus a product response (e.g. a lower-priced pack) addresses the real complaint. Deleting comments or out-shouting critics usually backfires.
exp.hi: Listening tabhi kaam ka hai jab insights decision-makers tak pahunchein. Imaandaar communication aur product response (jaise sasta pack) asli complaint ko address karta hai. Comments delete karna ya critics ko dabana aksar ulta padta hai.
exp.mr: Listening तेव्हाच उपयोगी जेव्हा insights निर्णय घेणाऱ्यांपर्यंत पोहोचतात. प्रामाणिक संवाद आणि product प्रतिसाद (उदा. स्वस्त pack) खरी तक्रार सोडवतो. Comments delete करणे किंवा टीकाकारांना दाबणे सहसा उलटते.

q.en: A Hyderabad IT services firm wants to reach decision-makers at 200 named enterprise accounts via LinkedIn Ads with ₹2L/month. Which approach fits best?
q.hi: Hyderabad ki ek IT services firm LinkedIn Ads se ₹2L/month mein 200 named enterprise accounts ke decision-makers tak pahunchna chahti hai. Kaunsa approach best hai?
q.mr: Hyderabad मधील एक IT services firm ₹2L/महिना मध्ये LinkedIn Ads ने 200 ठराविक enterprise accounts च्या decision-makers पर्यंत पोहोचू इच्छिते. कोणता approach सर्वात योग्य?

en: Target all LinkedIn users in India to keep CPC low
Use Audience Network only for cheap impressions
