Target people interested in 'technology' with no company filter
Upload the company list, layer job function and seniority, and measure account engagement and pipeline with sales
hi: CPC kam rakhne ke liye India ke saare LinkedIn users target karo
Saste impressions ke liye sirf Audience Network use karo
Bina company filter ke 'technology' interest walon ko target karo
Company list upload karo, job function va seniority layer karo, sales ke saath engagement aur pipeline measure karo
mr: CPC कमी ठेवण्यासाठी भारतातील सर्व LinkedIn users target करा
स्वस्त impressions साठी फक्त Audience Network वापरा
Company filter न लावता 'technology' interest असलेल्यांना target करा
Company list upload करा, job function आणि seniority जोडा, आणि sales सोबत account engagement व pipeline मोजा

exp.en: This is account-based marketing: a matched company list plus role filters puts spend on the right buying committees. Success is measured in account engagement and pipeline, not cheap clicks from people who can't buy.
exp.hi: Yeh account-based marketing hai: matched company list plus role filters se spend sahi buying committees pe jaata hai. Success account engagement aur pipeline se measure hoti hai, un logon ke saste clicks se nahi jo khareed hi nahi sakte.
exp.mr: हे account-based marketing आहे: matched company list आणि role filters मुळे खर्च योग्य buying committees वर जातो. यश account engagement आणि pipeline ने मोजले जाते, खरेदी करू न शकणाऱ्या लोकांच्या स्वस्त clicks ने नाही.

q.en: A skincare brand spends ₹50K/day on Meta at a ₹600 target CPA and wants ₹2L/day during a 5-day sale without CPA blowing up. Which plan is most robust?
q.hi: Ek skincare brand Meta pe ₹50K/day kharch karta hai ₹600 target CPA pe, aur 5-day sale mein ₹2L/day chahta hai bina CPA bigde. Sabse robust plan kya hai?
q.mr: एक skincare brand Meta वर ₹600 target CPA वर ₹50K/दिवस खर्च करतो, आणि 5 दिवसांच्या sale मध्ये CPA न बिघडता ₹2L/दिवस खर्च करू इच्छितो. सर्वात भक्कम plan कोणता?

en: Launch sale creatives and campaigns days ahead, scale in steps, and use a cost cap to guard CPA
Quadruple the budget on the first sale morning and never touch it again
Launch 40 brand-new ad sets on the sale day with fresh audiences
Keep the budget flat and hope organic covers the sale
hi: Sale creatives aur campaigns kuch din pehle launch karo, steps mein scale karo, aur CPA bachane ke liye cost cap use karo
Sale ki pehli subah budget chaar guna karo aur phir haath mat lagao
Sale ke din fresh audiences ke saath 40 naye ad sets launch karo
Budget flat rakho aur umeed karo ki organic sale sambhal lega
mr: Sale creatives आणि campaigns काही दिवस आधी launch करा, टप्प्याटप्प्याने scale करा, आणि CPA राखण्यासाठी cost cap वापरा
Sale च्या पहिल्या सकाळी budget चौपट करा आणि नंतर हात लावू नका
Sale च्या दिवशी नव्या audiences सह 40 नवे ad sets launch करा
Budget तसेच ठेवा आणि organic sale सांभाळेल अशी आशा करा

exp.en: Launching early lets campaigns finish learning before the sale, stepped scaling avoids shock, and a cost cap tells Meta not to buy conversions above your target, trading some volume for efficiency. Launching many new ad sets on sale day means they all start in learning.
exp.hi: Pehle launch karne se campaigns sale se pehle learning poori kar lete hain, steps mein scale karne se jhatka nahi lagta, aur cost cap Meta ko target se mehngi conversions khareedne se rokta hai (kuch volume kam, efficiency zyada). Sale ke din naye ad sets sab learning se hi shuru honge.
exp.mr: आधी launch केल्याने campaigns sale पूर्वी learning पूर्ण करतात, टप्प्याटप्प्याने scale केल्याने धक्का बसत नाही, आणि cost cap Meta ला target पेक्षा महाग conversions घेऊ देत नाही (थोडा volume कमी, efficiency जास्त). Sale च्या दिवशी नवे ad sets सगळे learning मधूनच सुरू होतील.

q.en: A pharma-adjacent wellness brand notices Meta's automatic creative enhancements have altered text and visuals in ads that carry legally reviewed claims. What's the right action?
q.hi: Ek pharma-adjacent wellness brand dekhta hai ki Meta ke automatic creative enhancements ne legally reviewed claims wale ads ke text aur visuals badal diye. Sahi action kya hai?
q.mr: एका pharma-adjacent wellness brand ला दिसते की Meta च्या automatic creative enhancements नी legally reviewed claims असलेल्या ads मधील text आणि visuals बदलले. योग्य पाऊल कोणते?

en: Keep them; any change that raises CTR is acceptable
Turn off the relevant enhancements for these ads, review live versions, and keep compliance sign-off on final creatives
Delete the ad account and start fresh
Remove all claims from every ad forever
hi: Rehne do; CTR badhane wala koi bhi change chalega
In ads ke liye relevant enhancements band karo, live versions review karo, aur final creatives pe compliance sign-off rakho
Ad account delete karke naya shuru karo
Har ad se saare claims hamesha ke liye hata do
mr: तसेच ठेवा; CTR वाढवणारा कोणताही बदल चालतो
या ads साठी संबंधित enhancements बंद करा, live versions तपासा, आणि final creatives वर compliance sign-off ठेवा
Ad account delete करून नवीन सुरू करा
प्रत्येक ad मधून सर्व claims कायमचे काढा

exp.en: Creative enhancements can be switched off individually. In regulated categories, the exact wording approved by legal must be what runs, so disable risky enhancements and check what actually serves. Throwing away the account or all claims is overkill.
exp.hi: Creative enhancements individually off ho sakte hain. Regulated categories mein wahi exact wording chalni chahiye jo legal ne approve ki, toh risky enhancements band karo aur check karo ki asal mein kya serve ho raha hai. Account ya saare claims hata dena overkill hai.
exp.mr: Creative enhancements स्वतंत्रपणे बंद करता येतात. Regulated categories मध्ये legal ने मंजूर केलेले नेमके शब्दच चालले पाहिजेत, म्हणून धोकादायक enhancements बंद करा आणि प्रत्यक्ष काय दिसते ते तपासा. Account किंवा सगळे claims काढणे अतिरेक आहे.

q.en: You duplicated an ad set to test a new landing page. The copy shows 30% lower CPA after 4 days, but the two ad sets targeted overlapping audiences. How should you make a trustworthy decision?
q.hi: Aapne naya landing page test karne ke liye ad set duplicate kiya. 4 din baad copy ka CPA 30% kam hai, par dono ad sets overlapping audiences target kar rahe the. Bharosemand decision kaise lein?
q.mr: नवे landing page test करण्यासाठी तुम्ही ad set duplicate केला. 4 दिवसांनी copy चा CPA 30% कमी आहे, पण दोन्ही ad sets overlapping audiences target करत होते. विश्वासार्ह निर्णय कसा घ्यावा?

en: Declare the copy the winner now; 30% is a big gap
Average the two CPAs and keep both running
Re-run it as a proper A/B test with split, non-overlapping audiences, one variable, and a preset metric and duration
Ask the team to vote on which landing page looks better
hi: Copy ko abhi winner declare karo; 30% bada farak hai
Dono CPA ka average nikaal ke dono chalate raho
Ise proper A/B test ki tarah dobara chalao: split, non-overlapping audiences, ek variable, pehle se tay metric aur duration
Team se vote karwao kaunsa landing page achha dikhta hai
mr: Copy ला आत्ताच winner जाहीर करा; 30% मोठा फरक आहे
दोन्ही CPA ची सरासरी काढून दोन्ही चालू ठेवा
हे proper A/B test म्हणून पुन्हा चालवा: split, non-overlapping audiences, एक variable, आधी ठरवलेला metric आणि कालावधी
कोणते landing page चांगले दिसते यावर team चे मत घ्या

exp.en: With overlapping audiences, the ad sets compete in the same auctions and delivery is uneven, so the gap may be noise. Meta's A/B test tool splits people into separate groups so one variable can be judged fairly, with enough time and conversions.
exp.hi: Overlapping audiences mein ad sets same auctions mein compete karte hain aur delivery uneven hoti hai, toh farak sirf noise ho sakta hai. Meta ka A/B test tool logon ko alag groups mein baant-ta hai taaki ek variable ko fairly judge kiya ja sake, kaafi time aur conversions ke saath.
exp.mr: Overlapping audiences मध्ये ad sets त्याच auctions मध्ये स्पर्धा करतात आणि delivery असमान होते, त्यामुळे फरक फक्त noise असू शकतो. Meta चे A/B test tool लोकांना वेगळ्या groups मध्ये विभागते म्हणजे पुरेसा वेळ आणि conversions सह एक variable न्याय्यपणे तपासता येतो.

q.en: A D2C brand has ₹5L for influencer marketing with a sales goal. The founder wants one big celebrity post. As the strategist, what's the strongest plan?
q.hi: Ek D2C brand ke paas sales goal ke saath influencer marketing ke liye ₹5L hain. Founder ek bada celebrity post chahta hai. Strategist ke roop mein sabse strong plan kya hai?
q.mr: एका D2C brand कडे sales च्या उद्देशाने influencer marketing साठी ₹5L आहेत. Founder ला एक मोठी celebrity post हवी आहे. Strategist म्हणून सर्वात मजबूत plan कोणता?

en: Spend it all on one celebrity post; bigger reach always wins
Split it equally among 500 nano creators with no tracking
Spend it on buying followers for the brand page first
Test a vetted mix of micro-creators with unique codes/UTMs, then put winners' content into partnership ads
hi: Saara ek celebrity post pe lagao; badi reach hamesha jeetti hai
Bina tracking ke 500 nano creators mein barabar baant do
Pehle brand page ke liye followers khareedne mein lagao
Vetted micro-creators ka mix unique codes/UTMs ke saath test karo, phir winners ka content partnership ads mein daalo
mr: सगळे एका celebrity post वर खर्च करा; मोठी reach नेहमी जिंकते
कोणत्याही tracking शिवाय 500 nano creators मध्ये समान वाटा
आधी brand page साठी followers विकत घेण्यावर खर्च करा
तपासलेल्या micro-creators चे mix unique codes/UTMs सह test करा, मग winners चे content partnership ads मध्ये टाका

exp.en: For a sales goal, a tracked portfolio shows which creators and messages actually sell, and partnership ads let you scale proven creator content with paid targeting. One celebrity post is a single, hard-to-measure bet.
exp.hi: Sales goal ke liye tracked portfolio dikhata hai kaunse creators aur messages sach mein bechte hain, aur partnership ads se proven creator content ko paid targeting ke saath scale kar sakte ho. Ek celebrity post ek hi, mushkil se measure hone wala daav hai.
exp.mr: Sales च्या उद्देशासाठी tracked portfolio दाखवतो की कोणते creators आणि messages खरोखर विकतात, आणि partnership ads मुळे सिद्ध झालेले creator content paid targeting सह scale करता येते. एक celebrity post म्हणजे एकच, मोजायला कठीण असा जुगार.

q.en: Your team wants to upload 20,000 customer phone numbers collected at billing counters to Meta for a Custom Audience. What's the most important check before uploading?
q.hi: Team billing counters pe collect kiye 20,000 customer phone numbers Meta pe Custom Audience ke liye upload karna chahti hai. Upload se pehle sabse zaroori check kya hai?
q.mr: Team ला billing counters वर गोळा केलेले 20,000 customer phone numbers Meta वर Custom Audience साठी upload करायचे आहेत. Upload करण्यापूर्वी सर्वात महत्त्वाची तपासणी कोणती?

en: Whether customers were informed and consented to marketing use, per the DPDP Act and Meta terms
Whether the file is under 5 MB
Whether numbers include +91 so the match rate is higher
Whether the audience is bigger than your competitor's
hi: Kya customers ko bataya gaya aur marketing use ki consent li gayi, DPDP Act aur Meta terms ke hisaab se
Kya file 5 MB se chhoti hai
Kya numbers mein +91 hai taaki match rate zyada ho
Kya audience competitor se badi hai
mr: ग्राहकांना कळवून marketing वापरासाठी संमती घेतली होती का, DPDP Act आणि Meta terms नुसार
File 5 MB पेक्षा लहान आहे का
Match rate जास्त व्हावा म्हणून numbers मध्ये +91 आहे का
Audience competitor पेक्षा मोठी आहे का

exp.en: Hashing protects data in transit, but you still need a lawful basis: under India's DPDP Act, 2023 and Meta's Custom Audience terms, people should have been informed and consented to marketing use. Country codes help match rate, but they're a formatting detail, not the key risk.
exp.hi: Hashing transit mein data bachata hai, par lawful basis phir bhi chahiye: India ke DPDP Act, 2023 aur Meta ke Custom Audience terms ke hisaab se logon ko bataya gaya ho aur marketing use ki consent di ho. Country code match rate badhata hai, par woh formatting hai, asli risk nahi.
exp.mr: Hashing मुळे data सुरक्षित जातो, पण lawful basis तरीही लागतो: भारताच्या DPDP Act, 2023 आणि Meta च्या Custom Audience terms नुसार लोकांना कळवलेले असावे आणि marketing वापरासाठी संमती दिलेली असावी. Country code match rate वाढवतो, पण तो formatting चा भाग आहे, मुख्य धोका नाही.

q.en: A CA-exam coaching YouTube channel gets 1M+ views a month on Shorts, but long-form views and course sign-ups are flat; Shorts viewers rarely watch full lectures. What's the best fix?
q.hi: Ek CA-exam coaching YouTube channel ko Shorts pe mahine ke 1M+ views milte hain, par long-form views aur course sign-ups flat hain; Shorts viewers full lectures kam hi dekhte hain. Best fix kya hai?
q.mr: एका CA-exam coaching YouTube channel ला Shorts वर महिन्याला 1M+ views मिळतात, पण long-form views आणि course sign-ups स्थिर आहेत; Shorts viewers पूर्ण lectures क्वचितच पाहतात. सर्वोत्तम उपाय कोणता?

en: Stop long-form entirely and post only Shorts
Make Shorts teasing a specific long video, link that related video, and judge by sign-ups
Post random viral trends to push Shorts views even higher
Upload full lectures cut into 60-second pieces with no context
hi: Long-form poori tarah band karke sirf Shorts post karo
Specific long video ko tease karne wale Shorts banao, woh related video link karo, sign-ups se judge karo
Shorts views aur badhane ke liye random viral trends post karo
Full lectures ko bina context 60-second tukdon mein upload karo
mr: Long-form पूर्णपणे बंद करून फक्त Shorts post करा
विशिष्ट long video tease करणारे Shorts बनवा, तो related video link करा, sign-ups वरून मूल्यांकन करा
Shorts views आणखी वाढवण्यासाठी random viral trends post करा
पूर्ण lectures संदर्भाशिवाय 60 सेकंदांच्या तुकड्यांत upload करा

exp.en: Shorts and long-form viewers often behave like different audiences. Topic-aligned Shorts that use YouTube's related-video link create a path to the full lecture, and sign-ups are the metric that matters. Random trends grow views from the wrong audience.
exp.hi: Shorts aur long-form viewers aksar alag audience ki tarah behave karte hain. Topic-aligned Shorts jo YouTube ka related-video link use karein, full lecture tak rasta banate hain, aur sign-ups hi asli metric hai. Random trends galat audience se views badhate hain.
exp.mr: Shorts आणि long-form viewers अनेकदा वेगळ्या audience सारखे वागतात. YouTube चा related-video link वापरणारे विषयाशी जुळणारे Shorts पूर्ण lecture पर्यंत मार्ग तयार करतात, आणि sign-ups हाच खरा metric आहे. Random trends चुकीच्या audience कडून views वाढवतात.

q.en: After a website redesign, Meta-reported purchases fell 60% overnight while Shopify orders stayed steady. CTR, CPM and frequency are unchanged. What should you do first?
q.hi: Website redesign ke baad Meta-reported purchases raaton-raat 60% gir gaye, jabki Shopify orders steady rahe. CTR, CPM aur frequency same hain. Pehle kya karna chahiye?
q.mr: Website redesign नंतर Meta-reported purchases एका रात्रीत 60% घटल्या, तर Shopify orders स्थिर राहिल्या. CTR, CPM आणि frequency बदललेले नाहीत. आधी काय करावे?

en: Replace all creatives because they have fatigued
Broaden targeting to find new buyers
Verify Pixel/CAPI events on the new checkout in Events Manager and fix tracking first
Double the budget to make up for lost purchases
hi: Saare creatives badlo kyunki woh fatigue ho gaye
Naye buyers ke liye targeting broad karo
Events Manager mein naye checkout ke Pixel/CAPI events verify karo aur pehle tracking theek karo
Khoye purchases ki bharpai ke liye budget double karo
mr: सगळे creatives बदला कारण ते fatigue झाले
नवे buyers शोधण्यासाठी targeting broad करा
Events Manager मध्ये नव्या checkout वरील Pixel/CAPI events तपासा आणि आधी tracking दुरुस्त करा
गमावलेल्या purchases भरून काढण्यासाठी budget दुप्पट करा

exp.en: Real orders are steady and ad metrics are unchanged, so the drop is in measurement, most likely events broken by the redesign. Until fixed, Meta is also optimizing on missing data. Changing creatives or budget would treat the wrong problem.
exp.hi: Asli orders steady hain aur ad metrics same hain, toh girawat measurement mein hai, shayad redesign se events toot gaye. Jab tak theek na ho, Meta missing data pe optimize kar raha hai. Creatives ya budget badalna galat problem ka ilaaj hoga.
exp.mr: खऱ्या orders स्थिर आहेत आणि ad metrics बदललेले नाहीत, म्हणजे घट measurement मध्ये आहे, बहुधा redesign मुळे events तुटले. दुरुस्त होईपर्यंत Meta अपूर्ण data वर optimize करत आहे. Creatives किंवा budget बदलणे म्हणजे चुकीच्या समस्येवर उपचार.
